title.zh: 卷358 列傳一百四十五 冯光熊 陆有仁 觉罗琅玕 乌大经 清安泰 常明 温承惠 颜检
title.en: Volume 358 Biographies 145: Feng Guangxiong, Lu Youren, Jue Luo Lang Gan, Wu Dajing, Qing An Tai, Chang Ming, Wen Chenghui, Yan Jian
title.raw: 卷358 列傳一百四十五 冯光熊 陆有仁 觉罗琅玕 乌大经 清安泰 常明 温承惠 颜检

sentences.zh: 列傳一百四十五

translations.literal: Biographies 145
translations.idiomatic: Biography 145

sentences.zh: 馮光熊陸有仁覺羅琅玕烏大經清安泰

translations.literal: Feng Guangxiong, Lu Youren, Jue Luo Langgan, Wu Dajing, Qing Antai
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangxiong, Lu Youren, Jue Luo Langgan, Wu Dajing, and Qing Antai

sentences.zh: 常明溫承惠顏檢

translations.literal: Chang Ming, Wen Chenghui, Yan Jian
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ming, Wen Chenghui, and Yan Jian

sentences.zh: 馮光熊，字太佔，浙江嘉興人。

translations.literal: Feng Guangxiong, style name Taizhan, was a native of Jiaxing, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangxiong, whose style was Taizhan, came from Jiaxing in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年舉人，考授中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong he became a provincial graduate, was appointed through examination as a Secretariat Drafter, and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Qianlong he passed the provincial examination, received appointment as a Secretariat drafter through examination, and served on the Grand Council staff.

sentences.zh: 累擢戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，從明瑞赴雲南，授鹽驛道，母憂歸，坐失察屬吏科派，奪職。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he followed Mingrui to Yunnan and was appointed Salt and Courier Commissioner; he returned home for mourning on his mother's death and was stripped of office for failure to supervise a subordinate who imposed unauthorized levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he accompanied Mingrui to Yunnan and was made salt and courier commissioner. After he went home for his mother's mourning, he lost his post for not preventing a subordinate from imposing unauthorized levies.

sentences.zh: 服闋，以員外郎起用，仍官戶部，直軍機，遷郎中。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was recalled as an Assistant Department Director, still in the Ministry of Revenue, served on the Grand Council, and was promoted to Director.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning period ended he was recalled as an assistant department director in the Ministry of Revenue, returned to Grand Council duty, and was promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 從尚書福隆安赴金川軍，授廣西右江道，署按察使兼鹽驛道。

translations.literal: He followed Minister Fulongan to the Jinchuan army, was appointed Guangxi Youjiang Circuit Intendant, and acted as Provincial Judge while also holding the Salt and Courier Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Minister Fulongan to the Jinchuan campaign, was appointed intendant of the Youjiang circuit in Guangxi, and served concurrently as acting provincial judge and salt and courier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 歷江西按察使、甘肅布政使。

translations.literal: He served successively as Jiangxi Provincial Judge and Gansu Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to serve as provincial judge of Jiangxi and administration commissioner of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，石峰堡回民作亂，籌畫戰守，儲設餉需具備。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year the Hui of Shifeng Fort rebelled; he planned defense and attack and had provisions and supplies fully prepared.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, when the Hui at Shifeng Fort rose in revolt, he planned the campaign and had rations and supplies fully in place.

sentences.zh: 以前江西巡撫郝碩迫索屬吏事覺，同官多獲譴，光熊亦緣坐奪官，留營效力。

translations.literal: When the matter of former Jiangxi governor Hao Shuo's extortion from subordinates came to light, many colleagues were punished; Guangxiong was also implicated and stripped of office, remaining at camp to serve in a subordinate capacity.
translations.idiomatic: When the case of former Jiangxi governor Hao Shuo's extortion from subordinates came to light, many officials were punished. Guangxiong was implicated as well, lost his post, and stayed with the army to serve in a reduced capacity.

sentences.zh: 事平，用福康安薦，起為安徽按察使。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, on Fuk'anggan's recommendation he was recalled as Anhui Provincial Judge.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was suppressed, Fuk'anggan recommended him and he was restored as provincial judge of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 洊擢湖南巡撫，調山西。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Hunan governor and transferred to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor of Hunan and then transferred to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 時議河東鹽課改歸地丁，光熊疏言：「河東鹽行山、陝、河南三省，商力積疲，易商加價，俱無所濟。

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of converting Hedong salt duties into land-tax surcharges; Guangxiong memorialized: 'Hedong salt is marketed in Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Henan; merchant strength has long been exhausted, and changing merchants or raising prices would both avail nothing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time officials were debating whether to fold Hedong salt duties into the land-tax surcharge. Guangxiong submitted a memorial: 'Hedong salt is sold across Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Henan. Merchant capital has been exhausted for years, and neither changing contractors nor raising prices would help.

sentences.zh: 若課歸地丁，聽民販運，無官課雜費、兵役盤詰、關津留難，較為便宜。

translations.literal: If the duty were merged into the land-tax surcharge and the people were allowed to transport and sell freely, without official levies, miscellaneous fees, military harassment, or delays at passes and barriers, it would be more advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: If the duty were merged into the land-tax surcharge and ordinary people were allowed to transport and sell salt freely, without official levies, miscellaneous fees, military harassment, or delays at passes and barriers, the cost would be lower.

sentences.zh: 山西州縣半領引行鹽，半食土鹽、蒙古鹽，仍納引稅​​。

translations.literal: In Shanxi prefectures and counties half used official salt coupons and half consumed local or Mongolian salt, yet still paid coupon tax.
translations.idiomatic: In Shanxi, half the counties used licensed salt and half relied on local or Mongolian salt, yet all still paid coupon tax.

sentences.zh: 其間或引多而地丁少，或引少而地丁多，徵之三省皆然。

translations.literal: Among them some had many coupons but little land-tax surcharge, or few coupons but much surcharge; this was so in levying across all three provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In some places coupon sales were high but the land-tax surcharge was low; in others the reverse was true. The same imbalance appeared in all three provinces.

sentences.zh: 請將課額四十八萬餘兩通計均攤。

translations.literal: He requested that the duty quota of more than 480,000 taels be averaged in a single calculation.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the total duty of more than 480,000 taels be spread evenly across the region.

sentences.zh: 」允之。

translations.literal: ' The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ' The court approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，上幸五台，各疆吏先後奏陳，自鹽課改革後，價頓減落，民便安之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year the emperor visited Wutai; governors-general and governors reported in succession that since the salt reform prices had fallen sharply and the people were content.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year, when the emperor visited Wutai, frontier officials reported one after another that since the salt reform prices had dropped sharply and the people were at ease.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉光熊調劑得宜，賜花翎、黃馬褂，署工部侍郎。

translations.literal: An edict praised Guangxiong's successful adjustment, granted peacock feather and yellow jacket, and appointed him acting Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised Guangxiong for adjusting the policy well, granted him a peacock feather and a yellow jacket, and named him acting vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授貴州巡撫，調雲南。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Guizhou governor and transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Guizhou and then transferred to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，署雲南總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he acted as Yunnan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he served as acting governor-general of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 明年，大塘苗石柳鄧叛擾銅仁，光熊赴松桃防禦，以思州田堧坪、鎮遠四十八溪、思南大坪，密邇楚苗，且扼銅仁後路，分兵屯守。

translations.literal: The next year the Datang Miao Shi Liudeng rebelled and harassed Tongren; Guangxiong went to Songtao to defend, and because Sizhou Tianhuanping, Zhenyuan's Forty-eight Streams, and Sinan Daping lay close to the Chu Miao and also controlled Tongren's rear route, he divided troops to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Datang Miao leader Shi Liudeng rebelled and raided Tongren. Guangxiong went to Songtao to organize the defense. Because Tianhuanping in Sizhou, the Forty-eight Streams of Zhenyuan, and Daping in Sinan lay close to the Hunan Miao and also controlled Tongren's rear approaches, he posted troops at each point.

sentences.zh: 苗匪急攻松桃、正大，不得逞。

translations.literal: The Miao rebels pressed attacks on Songtao and Zhengda but could not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao rebels pressed hard against Songtao and Zhengda but could not break through.

sentences.zh: 旋赴銅仁治餉需，偕總督福康安治軍設防，規畫稱旨，命留貴州巡撫任。

translations.literal: He then went to Tongren to manage provisions, and together with Governor-General Fuk'anggan organized the army and defenses; his planning pleased the throne, and he was ordered to retain the Guizhou governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Tongren to handle supplies, worked with Governor-General Fuk'anggan to organize the army and defenses, and pleased the court with his planning. He was told to keep his post as governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，事平，奏請銅仁、正大改建石城，以資捍衛，從​​之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, when the affair was settled, he memorialized that Tongren and Zhengda should be rebuilt as stone-walled cities for defense; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing, after the rebellion was suppressed, he asked that Tongren and Zhengda be rebuilt as stone-walled cities for defense. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 會仲苗又起，偕總督勒保督率鎮將，聯合滇、黔、楚、粵諸軍剿撫，事具勒保傳。

translations.literal: When the secondary Miao rose again, together with Governor-General Lebao he supervised regional commanders and united armies from Yunnan, Guizhou, Huguang, and Guangdong to suppress and pacify; the matter is recorded in Lebao's biography.
translations.idiomatic: When the secondary Miao rebellion broke out again, he joined Governor-General Lebao in directing the regional commanders and coordinating armies from Yunnan, Guizhou, Huguang, and Guangdong to suppress and pacify them. The campaign is described in Lebao's biography.

sentences.zh: 光熊分檄將吏，解歸化廳圍，肅清播東、播西兩路，降安順、廣順所屬苗寨。

translations.literal: Guangxiong issued separate orders to officers, relieved the siege of Guihua Subprefecture, cleared the eastern and western Bo routes, and induced the surrender of Miao stockades under Anshun and Guangshun.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxiong sent orders to his officers, lifted the siege of Guihua subprefecture, cleared the eastern and western Bo routes, and brought the Miao stockades under Anshun and Guangshun to surrender.

sentences.zh: 仲苗平，偕勒保奏上善後四事，請隨徵武舉、武生及鄉勇，就近補充弁兵餘丁，給難民棲止、牛具費用，儲糧備兵民就食，清釐田畝，靖苗、漢之爭。

translations.literal: When the secondary Miao were pacified, together with Lebao he memorialized four postwar measures: to recruit military licentiates, military students, and local militia as they were levied, fill nearby vacancies among officers and surplus soldiers, grant refugees shelter and ox and tool expenses, store grain so troops and people could be fed, clarify land registers, and settle disputes between Miao and Han.
translations.idiomatic: After the secondary Miao were pacified, he and Lebao submitted four postwar measures: recruit military licentiates, military students, and local militia as they were called up; fill nearby vacancies among officers and surplus soldiers; provide refugees with shelter and funds for oxen and tools; store grain so troops and civilians could be fed; clarify land registers; and settle disputes between Miao and Han.

sentences.zh: 自軍興以來，凡所措置，多邀嘉許。

translations.literal: Since the outbreak of war, nearly all his arrangements had won praise.
translations.idiomatic: From the start of the campaign, nearly everything he arranged won praise from the court.

sentences.zh: 勒保移師入川，善後專任光熊。

translations.literal: Lebao moved his army into Sichuan, and postwar affairs were entrusted solely to Guangxiong.
translations.idiomatic: When Lebao moved his army into Sichuan, postwar affairs were left entirely to Guangxiong.

sentences.zh: 三年春，复疏請申禁漢民典買苗田，及重債盤剝，驅役苗佃；

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he again memorialized to reiterate the ban on Han purchasing Miao land on mortgage, heavy-debt exploitation, and driving Miao tenants as labor;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he again asked the court to enforce the ban on Han mortgaging Miao land, on exploitative high-interest lending, and on forcing Miao tenants into labor service;

sentences.zh: 禁客民差役居攝苗寨；

translations.literal: to forbid sojourners and yamen runners from residing in and controlling Miao stockades;
translations.idiomatic: to forbid migrants and yamen runners from living in and controlling Miao stockades;

sentences.zh: 酌裁把事土舍亭長，定夫徭工價，以利窮苗；

translations.literal: to reduce appropriately the baoshi, tusi, and tingzhang offices and fix corvée labor prices to benefit impoverished Miao;
translations.idiomatic: to trim the baoshi, tusi, and tingzhang offices and set fair corvée wages to relieve impoverished Miao;

sentences.zh: 酌設苗弁，以資管束：悉報可。

translations.literal: and to establish Miao officers as appropriate for control: all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: and to appoint Miao officers where appropriate for local control. All of these proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔光熊治理有聲，年近八旬，召授兵部侍郎，尋擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year an edict noted Guangxiong's distinguished governance; though nearly eighty, he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of War, then soon promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the throne noted Guangxiong's distinguished record of governance. Though he was nearly eighty, he was summoned to the capital, appointed vice minister of war, and soon promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒，上念前勞，賜祭一壇。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died; the emperor, mindful of his earlier service, granted one sacrificial altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he died. Mindful of his earlier service, the emperor granted one court sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 陸有仁，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Lu Youren was a native of Qiantang, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Youren came from Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年進士，授刑部主事，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a Ministry of Justice clerk, and was promoted repeatedly to Director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the thirty-fourth year of Qianlong, entered the Ministry of Justice as a clerk, and rose through successive promotions to director.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，出為廣西梧州知府，調太平。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he went out as Wuzhou prefect in Guangxi and was transferred to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year he was posted as prefect of Wuzhou in Guangxi and then transferred to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，安南內訌，夷眷來奔，有仁處置得宜。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year Annam suffered internal strife and Yi dependents fled in; Youren handled the matter appropriately.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year, when Annam fell into civil strife and Yi dependents fled across the border, Youren handled the situation well.

sentences.zh: 會擢福建延建邵道，總督孫士毅請留防邊。

translations.literal: He was then promoted to Fujian Yanjian-Sha Circuit Intendant, but Governor-General Sun Shiyi requested that he remain for frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to intendant of the Yanjian-Sha circuit in Fujian, but Governor-General Sun Shiyi asked that he be kept on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 尋調督糧道，歷山東按察使、直隸布政使。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Grain Transport Commissioner, and served successively as Shandong Provincial Judge and Zhili Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to grain transport commissioner and later served as provincial judge of Shandong and administration commissioner of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，坐在山東讞獄草率，降甘肅按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year, for perfunctory handling of a Shandong trial, he was demoted to Gansu Provincial Judge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he was demoted to provincial judge of Gansu for handling a Shandong trial too casually.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，擢刑部侍郎，留治甘肅賑務，宜綿赴陝剿教匪，命攝陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted to Vice Minister of Justice, remained to manage Gansu relief, and when Yimian went to Shaanxi to suppress the sect rebels was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted to vice minister of justice and stayed to manage Gansu relief work. When Yimian went to Shaanxi to suppress the sect rebels, Youren was ordered to serve as acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 二年，匪由河南竄硃陽關，逼雒南。

translations.literal: In the second year the rebels from Henan slipped through Zhuyang Pass and pressed on Luonan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the rebels slipped from Henan through Zhuyang Pass and threatened Luonan.

sentences.zh: 疏請偕西寧鎮總兵富爾賽馳赴潼、商，又調甘涼鎮兵會剿，詔軍務責巡撫，有仁應駐甘肅，親身赴陝，跡涉張皇，命回蘭州，停止所調鎮兵。

translations.literal: He memorialized to rush with Xining garrison commander Fu'ersai to Tong and Shang, and also called Gansu-Liang garrison troops for joint suppression; an edict held that military affairs were the governor's responsibility, Youren should remain in Gansu, and his personal rush to Shaanxi smacked of alarm; he was ordered back to Lanzhou and the garrison troops he had called were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to hurry with Xining garrison commander Fu'ersai to Tongzhou and Shangzhou and also called in troops from the Gansu-Liang garrison. The court replied that military affairs were the governor's responsibility, that Youren should stay in Gansu, and that his personal rush into Shaanxi looked alarmist. He was ordered back to Lanzhou and the garrison troops he had called were stood down.

sentences.zh: 時宜綿檄調撒拉爾回兵二千赴興安，有仁並令暫停，上以漢中兵單，待回兵截剿，乃教匪竄漢陰而回兵尚滯循化，斥有仁一經申飭，於應援之兵，亦屢催罔顧，詔褫職鞫訊，尋原之，發四川效力。

translations.literal: At the time Yimian had ordered two thousand Salar Muslim troops to Xing'an; Youren also had them temporarily halted. The emperor, because Hanzhong's forces were few, had awaited Muslim troops to intercept, yet the sect rebels slipped into Hanyin while the Muslim troops still lingered in Xunhua; he rebuked Youren that after one reprimand he still repeatedly ignored orders on reinforcing troops, stripped his office for trial, soon pardoned him, and sent him to serve in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yimian had ordered two thousand Salar Muslim troops to Xing'an, and Youren had them held back as well. The emperor had wanted those troops to intercept the rebels because Hanzhong was thinly garrisoned, but the sect rebels slipped into Hanyin while the Muslim troops were still delayed in Xunhua. The court rebuked Youren for ignoring repeated orders about reinforcements, stripped him of office for trial, soon pardoned him, and sent him to serve in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 授陝西按察使，遷布政使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Shaanxi Provincial Judge and promoted to Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed provincial judge of Shaanxi and then promoted to administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三年，襄陽賊高均德犯陝西，敘防堵功，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the third year the Xiangyang rebel Gao Junde invaded Shaanxi; for defensive blocking merit he was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when the Xiangyang rebel Gao Junde invaded Shaanxi, he was rewarded for blocking the advance and granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 五年，召為工部侍郎，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was summoned as Vice Minister of Works and transferred to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was recalled to serve as vice minister of works and then transferred to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 授陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 先是那彥成在陝，勸民築寨堡，計藍田、郿、鄠、寶雞、商州、鎮安、商南、孝義、五郎共五百四十一處；

translations.literal: Earlier Nayancheng in Shaanxi had urged the people to build stockade forts, planning five hundred forty-one sites in Lantian, Mei, Hu, Baoji, Shangzhou, Zhen'an, Shangnan, Xiaoyi, and Wulang;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Nayancheng was in Shaanxi, he had urged the people to build stockade forts, planning five hundred forty-one sites across Lantian, Mei, Hu, Baoji, Shangzhou, Zhen'an, Shangnan, Xiaoyi, and Wulang;

sentences.zh: 台佈為巡撫，复議漢中二棧為軍餉要道，於寶雞、鳳縣、留壩、褒城、寧羌各驛築堡，以周三里為度，徙民屯糧。

translations.literal: Taibu as governor again proposed that the two Hanzhong routes were vital for army provisions, and that forts should be built at the stations of Baoji, Fengxian, Liuba, Baochang, and Ningqiang, with a circumference of three li as the standard and people relocated to store grain.
translations.idiomatic: When Taibu became governor, he argued again that the two Hanzhong routes were vital supply lines and proposed building forts at the stations of Baoji, Fengxian, Liuba, Baochang, and Ningqiang, each with a three-li perimeter, and relocating people to store grain there.

sentences.zh: 至是尚未盡實行，嚴詔切責。

translations.literal: By this time the plan had still not been fully carried out, and a stern edict sharply rebuked the delay.
translations.idiomatic: By then the plan had still not been fully carried out, and the court issued a stern rebuke.

sentences.zh: 有仁疏言：「川、陝情形不同，四川地居天險，如大成寨、大團包、方山坪等寨，每處可容數万人，小者亦數千人。

translations.literal: Youren memorialized: 'The situations in Sichuan and Shaanxi differ. Sichuan lies in natural strongholds; stockades such as Dacheng, Datuanbao, and Fangshanping can each hold tens of thousands, and even the smaller ones hold several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Youren submitted a memorial: 'Sichuan and Shaanxi are not the same. Sichuan sits in natural strongholds. Stockades such as Dacheng, Datuanbao, and Fangshanping can each hold tens of thousands of people, and even the smaller ones hold several thousand.

sentences.zh: 賊據之可抗官兵，民守之亦可拒賊。

translations.literal: If rebels held them they could resist government troops; if the people held them they could also repel rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Held by rebels, they could resist government troops; held by civilians, they could repel rebels as well.

sentences.zh: 如南山內層巒疊嶂，無寬敞環抱之所，止能於陡險山巔，就勢結構，每寨止容數百人至千餘人。

translations.literal: In the southern mountains within, ranges rise in layers with no broad encircling ground; one could only build on steep dangerous peaks according to the terrain, and each stockade held only several hundred to a little over a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the southern mountains, ridges rise in layers and there is no broad ground for encircling walls. Forts can be built only on steep peaks according to the terrain, and each stockade holds only a few hundred to a little over a thousand people.

sentences.zh: 蜀山多膏腴稻田，民居稠密，其勢易合。

translations.literal: Shu mountains have many fertile rice fields and dense settlements, so combining forces is easy.
translations.idiomatic: The mountains of Shu have fertile rice fields and dense settlements, so people there can combine easily.

sentences.zh: 陝西老林，惟棚民流寓，零星墾種，隔十里數十里，始有民居十數戶。

translations.literal: Shaanxi's old forests have only shed-dwellers as sojourners, farming in scattered patches; only after ten or several tens of li does one find a dozen-odd households.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaanxi's old-growth forests there are only migrant shed-dwellers farming scattered plots. Ten or even several tens of li may separate one cluster of a dozen households from the next.

sentences.zh: 若糾合數村共築一堡，則南村之人欲近南，北村之人欲近北，惟秦隴以西，人皆土著，無不踴躍興工。

translations.literal: If several villages were joined to build one fort, southerners would want it near the south and northerners near the north; only west of Qin and Long, where all were natives, did everyone eagerly take up the work.
translations.idiomatic: If several villages were forced to build one fort together, people in southern villages would want it farther south and those in northern villages farther north. Only west of Qin and Long, where the population was native, did people take up the work eagerly.

sentences.zh: 秋間賊入西棧，每約彼此各不相犯，而寨民必乘間截其尾隊，奪其牲畜，不使晏然空過。

translations.literal: In autumn when rebels entered the western route they often agreed not to harm one another's stockades, yet stockade people always seized chances to cut their rear columns, seize livestock, and not let them pass in peace.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, when rebels entered the western route, they often agreed to leave one another's stockades alone. Yet stockade defenders would seize chances to cut off their rear columns, seize their livestock, and never let them pass unhindered.

sentences.zh: 其西安、同州、鳳翔三府，與漢南附近川省之區，皆多土著，審利害，每邑結有堡寨，或百餘或數百。

translations.literal: In Xi'an, Tongzhou, and Fengxiang prefectures and the Hanzhong south areas near Sichuan, natives were numerous, understood advantage and harm, and each district had stockades numbering over a hundred or several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefectures of Xi'an, Tongzhou, and Fengxiang, and in the Hanzhong south districts near Sichuan, there were many native settlers who understood local advantage. Each district already had stockades numbering from over a hundred to several hundred.

sentences.zh: 其漢北山內近亦一律興工，又恐結寨後民丁但知守寨，而於賊出入要隘轉無堵禦；

translations.literal: In the northern Han mountains construction had recently begun uniformly, yet he feared that after stockades were built the militia would only know how to defend them while key passes where rebels came and went would go unblocked;
translations.idiomatic: Construction had recently begun uniformly in the northern Han mountains as well, but he feared that once stockades were built the militia would only defend the forts themselves while the key passes the rebels used would go unguarded;

sentences.zh: 復令於寨堡之外，每寨撥數百數十人合力守卡，以杜窺伺。

translations.literal: he therefore ordered outside each stockade that several hundred or several dozen men from each be assigned jointly to guard checkpoints and forestall scouting.
translations.idiomatic: he therefore ordered that outside each stockade several hundred or several dozen men be assigned jointly to guard checkpoints and block enemy reconnaissance.

sentences.zh: 請分區責成各道，刻期完竣。

translations.literal: He requested that each circuit be charged by district and completed by a fixed deadline.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that each circuit be held responsible by district and that the work be finished by a fixed deadline.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: ' The memorial was received and noted.
translations.idiomatic: ' The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 有仁與額勒登保規畫築堡團練，著有成效。

translations.literal: Youren and Eledengbao planned stockade building and militia training with marked success.
translations.idiomatic: Youren and Eledengbao planned the stockade-building and militia-training program with marked success.

sentences.zh: 撫輯難民無歸者，以安康、白河等處叛產，及南山客民荒田，量給安插。

translations.literal: He pacified refugees with nowhere to return, allotting rebel confiscations in Ankang, Baihe, and elsewhere, together with abandoned fields of southern mountain sojourners, for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: He resettled refugees with nowhere to return, allotting confiscated rebel property in Ankang, Baihe, and elsewhere, together with abandoned fields of migrant farmers in the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 六年，分撥兵勇防守總要隘口，奏請於五郎、孝義等處專派大員團練堵剿，以專責成。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he divided troops to defend all vital passes and memorialized to assign senior officers at Wulang, Xiaoyi, and elsewhere specifically to train militia for blocking and suppression with clear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he posted troops at all vital passes and asked that senior officers be assigned at Wulang, Xiaoyi, and elsewhere specifically to organize militia for blocking and suppression.

sentences.zh: 川匪逼黑河，遣總兵齊郎阿、通判雒昂截擊，餘匪東竄牛尾河，副將韓自昌殲之，被優敘。

translations.literal: When Sichuan rebels pressed on Hei River he sent Regional Commander Qilang'a and Subprefect Luo Ang to intercept; the remainder fled east to Niwei River and Vice Commander Han Zichang annihilated them, and he received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When Sichuan rebels threatened Hei River, he sent regional commander Qilang'a and subprefect Luo Ang to intercept them. The remainder fled east to Niwei River, where vice commander Han Zichang destroyed them. Youren received special commendation for this.

sentences.zh: 有仁治陝三年，經理餉需，先事綢繆，撙節不濫，搜捕餘匪甚力，屢詔褒嘉。

translations.literal: Youren governed Shaanxi for three years, managed provisions with forethought, economized without waste, searched out remaining rebels vigorously, and was repeatedly praised by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Youren governed Shaanxi for three years. He managed supplies with forethought, spent carefully without waste, pursued remaining rebels vigorously, and was repeatedly praised by edict.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒，優恤，官其子繼祖主事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died; exceptional condolence was granted and his son Jizu was given a Ministry clerkship.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he died. The court granted exceptional condolence and appointed his son Jizu as a ministry clerk.

sentences.zh: 覺羅琅玕，隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: Jue Luo Langgan belonged to the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jue Luo Langgan belonged to the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 捐納筆帖式，累遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He purchased appointment as a clerical secretary and was promoted repeatedly to Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased appointment as a clerical secretary and rose through successive promotions to director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 超擢內閣學士，出為江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: He was promoted exceptionally to Grand Secretariat Academician and went out as Jiangsu Provincial Judge.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted exceptionally to grand secretariat academician and then posted as provincial judge of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，召授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong he was recalled and appointed vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 逾年，授浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，大兵剿台灣林爽文，琅玕儲穀二十萬石於乍浦、寧波、溫州，由海道輸運，高宗嘉之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, when the great army suppressed Lin Shuangwen in Taiwan, Langgan stored two hundred thousand shi of grain at Zhapu, Ningbo, and Wenzhou and shipped it by sea; Gaozong praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year, when the main army suppressed Lin Shuangwen in Taiwan, Langgan stored two hundred thousand shi of grain at Zhapu, Ningbo, and Wenzhou and shipped it by sea. Emperor Gaozong praised him for this.

sentences.zh: 坐審擬海盜失當，吏議當革職，詔寬免，自請罰銀三萬兩。

translations.literal: For improper review of a pirate case, the personnel office recommended dismissal; an edict pardoned him, and he himself requested a fine of thirty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: For mishandling a pirate case, the personnel office recommended dismissal. The emperor pardoned him, and Langgan volunteered a fine of thirty thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 嘉善縣吏浮收，按問得實，上以浙漕積弊，琅玕不勝任，命解職，予頭等侍衛，赴哈密辦事。

translations.literal: Jiashan county clerks were found on investigation to have over-collected; the emperor, because of long-standing abuses in Zhejiang grain transport, held Langgan unfit for office, ordered his dismissal, granted First Rank Bodyguard, and sent him to Hami on assignment.
translations.idiomatic: An investigation proved that Jiashan county clerks had over-collected taxes. Because of long-standing abuses in Zhejiang grain transport, the emperor judged Langgan unfit for office, dismissed him, granted him the rank of first-class bodyguard, and sent him to Hami on assignment.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，坐監修浙江海塘工程損壞，琅玕在任未親勘，詔責賠修，應銀二十二萬七千有奇，免其半。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, for damage to the Zhejiang seawall works he had supervised without personal inspection while in office, an edict ordered compensation for repairs amounting to more than 227,000 taels, of which half was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he was held responsible for damage to the Zhejiang seawall works he had supervised without inspecting them in person. The court ordered him to pay more than 227,000 taels for repairs and then remitted half the amount.

sentences.zh: 歷葉爾羌辦事大臣、喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He served successively as Yarkand Commissioner and Kashgar Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as commissioner at Yarkand and assistant commissioner at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 坐家人販玉，解任回京。

translations.literal: For household members trafficking jade he was dismissed and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When household members were found trafficking jade, he was dismissed and returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋予郎中銜，為熱河避暑山莊總管。

translations.literal: Soon he was given Director rank and made superintendent of the Rehe Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was given director rank and appointed superintendent of the Rehe Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，以三等侍衛充古城領隊大臣，召授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, as Third Rank Bodyguard he served as Gucheng expedition leader and was summoned as Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing he served as expedition leader at Gucheng in the capacity of a third-rank bodyguard, then was recalled and appointed vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 五年，授貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 剿擒廣順等寨苗楊文泰等，詔嘉獎，加總督銜。

translations.literal: He suppressed and captured the Guangshun stockade Miao Yang Wentai and others; an edict praised him and added governor-general rank.
translations.idiomatic: He suppressed the Miao of Guangshun and other stockades and captured Yang Wentai and others. The court praised him and granted him governor-general rank.

sentences.zh: 未幾，就擢雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted in place to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was promoted to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，貴州石峴苗叛，巡撫伊桑阿赴銅仁剿治，未即平，詔琅玕往督師，而調伊桑阿雲南。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Shixian Miao of Guizhou rebelled; Governor Yisang'a went to Tongren to suppress them but did not pacify them promptly; Langgan was ordered to supervise the army while Yisang'a was transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Shixian Miao of Guizhou rebelled. Governor Yisang'a went to Tongren to suppress them but failed to pacify the region promptly. Langgan was ordered to take command while Yisang'a was transferred to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 伊桑阿因按察使常明攻克石峴有所擒獲，遂謊奏親往督戰，苗皆歸伏，軍事已竣。

translations.literal: Because Provincial Judge Chang Ming had captured some rebels in taking Shixian, Yisang'a falsely memorialized that he had personally supervised the fighting, that the Miao had all submitted, and that military affairs were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Because provincial judge Chang Ming had taken Shixian and captured some rebels, Yisang'a falsely reported that he had personally supervised the fighting, that all the Miao had submitted, and that the campaign was over.

sentences.zh: 及琅玕至，難民擁道訴其誣，遂督兵進剿，攻克上潮、下潮諸寨，始肅清。

translations.literal: When Langgan arrived, refugees blocked the road to accuse the deception; he then supervised troops in advance, took the upper and lower Chao stockades, and only then achieved pacification.
translations.idiomatic: When Langgan arrived, refugees blocked his path to accuse Yisang'a of lying. He then led the army forward, captured the upper and lower Chao stockades, and only then restored order.

sentences.zh: 會初彭齡劾伊桑阿貪劣，下琅玕鞫實，上尤罪其欺罔，誅之。

translations.literal: When Chu Pengling impeached Yisang'a for greed and misconduct, the case was referred to Langgan for verification; the emperor especially condemned the deception and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Chu Pengling impeached Yisang'a for greed and misconduct, the case was referred to Langgan for verification. The emperor condemned Yisang'a above all for deception and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 詔斥琅玕於伊桑阿未親往石峴，避嫌瞻徇，降二品頂帶。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Langgan for, when Yisang'a had not gone personally to Shixian, avoiding suspicion yet showing partiality, and reduced him to second-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked Langgan for having shown partiality toward Yisang'a when Yisang'a had not gone to Shixian in person, and reduced his insignia to the second rank.

sentences.zh: 七年，維西夷恆乍繃與其黨臘者布作亂，禿樹、出亨附之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Weixi Yi Hengzhabeng and his follower Lazhebu rebelled, and Tushu and Chuhang joined them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Weixi Yi leader Hengzhabeng and his follower Lazhebu rebelled, joined by Tushu and Chuhang.

sentences.zh: 琅玕率總兵張玉龍入山剿捕，克阿喃多賊寨，進攻諸別古山，獲禿樹。

translations.literal: Langgan led Regional Commander Zhang Yulong into the mountains to suppress them, took the rebel stockade of Ananduo, advanced on Zhubiegu Mountain, and captured Tushu.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan led regional commander Zhang Yulong into the mountains to suppress them, captured the rebel stockade of Ananduo, advanced on Zhubiegu Mountain, and captured Tushu.

sentences.zh: 玉龍克小維西夷人，縛臘者布獻軍前磔之。

translations.literal: Yulong subdued the lesser Weixi Yi, bound Lazhebu, and presented him before the army to be dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: Yulong subdued the lesser Weixi Yi, bound Lazhebu, and presented him before the army to be executed by dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 進攻康普，恆乍繃遁瀾滄江外，獲其孥。

translations.literal: He advanced on Kangpu; Hengzhabeng fled beyond the Lancang River and his family was captured.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced on Kangpu. Hengzhabeng fled beyond the Lancang River, and his family was captured.

sentences.zh: 分兵攻吉尾、樹苗，琅玕駐劍川，斷賊後路，敗之於通甸、小川，克迴龍廠。

translations.literal: He divided troops to attack Jiwei and Shumiao; Langgan remained at Jianchuan to cut the rebels' retreat, defeated them at Tongdian and Xiaochuan, and took Huilong Factory.
translations.idiomatic: He divided his forces to attack Jiwei and Shumiao while Langgan remained at Jianchuan to cut off the rebels' retreat. They defeated the rebels at Tongdian and Xiaochuan and captured Huilong Factory.

sentences.zh: 尋圍剿上江山箐賊，殲其渠，餘眾乞降。

translations.literal: He then surrounded and suppressed the bandits of Shangjiang Mountain Stockade, destroyed their leaders, and the remainder begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He then surrounded the bandits at Shangjiang Mountain Stockade, killed their leaders, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 琅玕以恆乍繃勢蹙，疏請撤兵，提督烏大經率兵二千駐防。

translations.literal: Langgan, because Hengzhabeng's forces were pressed, memorialized to withdraw troops; Provincial Military Commissioner Wu Dajing led two thousand men to garrison the area.
translations.idiomatic: When Hengzhabeng's forces were pressed, Langgan asked to withdraw troops and left Provincial Military Commissioner Wu Dajing with two thousand men to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 賊诇官軍已退，乘水涸潛渡，糾江內降倮，复肆劫掠。

translations.literal: The rebels learned the government army had withdrawn; when the river ran low they crossed secretly, rallied surrendered Luo within the river, and again plundered freely.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels learned that the government troops had withdrawn. When the river ran low they crossed in secret, rallied surrendered Luo tribesmen on the near bank, and again began raiding.

sentences.zh: 琅玕馳抵劍川，恆乍繃遁走。

translations.literal: Langgan rushed to Jianchuan and Hengzhabeng fled.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan hurried to Jianchuan, and Hengzhabeng fled.

sentences.zh: 八年，上以首逆未獲，命永保接辦軍務。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because the chief rebel had not been captured, the emperor ordered Yongbao to take over military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because the chief rebel had still not been captured, the emperor ordered Yongbao to take over the campaign.

sentences.zh: 琅玕已擒斬漢奸張有斌，臨江扎筏，聲言渡兵江外，倮倮震悚，詣軍門乞降，琅玕令誘導諸寨擒賊自效。

translations.literal: Langgan had already captured and executed the Han traitor Zhang Youbin; he built rafts along the river and announced he would cross troops beyond the river; the Luo were terrified and came to the camp to surrender; Langgan ordered them to lure stockades into capturing rebels to prove themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan had already captured and executed the Han collaborator Zhang Youbin. He built rafts along the river and announced that troops would cross to the far bank. The Luo were terrified and came to the camp to surrender. Langgan ordered them to guide the stockades in capturing rebels to prove their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 九月，恆乍繃潛匿山箐，官軍搜獲之，餘黨盡殲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Hengzhabeng hid in a mountain stockade; government troops searched him out and the remaining followers were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Hengzhabeng was found hiding in a mountain stockade. Government troops captured him and annihilated his remaining followers.

sentences.zh: 事平，予議敘。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, merit review was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was suppressed, he was recommended for merit review.

sentences.zh: 琅玕以維西僻處邊隅，各夷雜居江內外，稽察難週，疏請於維西、麗江等五路設頭人，給頂帶，約束夷眾。

translations.literal: Langgan, because Weixi lay remote on the frontier and various Yi lived mixed on both sides of the river making inspection difficult, memorialized to establish headmen on five routes including Weixi and Lijiang, grant insignia, and restrain the Yi populations.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan argued that Weixi lay remote on the frontier and that various Yi peoples lived mixed on both sides of the river, making thorough inspection difficult. He asked to appoint headmen on five routes including Weixi and Lijiang, grant them insignia, and use them to restrain the local Yi.

sentences.zh: 又以維西南北路及鶴麗鎮、劍川諸汛皆要地，請裁馬為步，添兵八百，分佈要隘，邊境遂安。

translations.literal: He also held that the north and south routes of Weixi and the garrisons of Heli Town and Jianchuan were all vital points; he requested converting cavalry to infantry, adding eight hundred troops, and distributing them at key passes, and the border was then secure.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that the northern and southern routes of Weixi and the garrisons of Heli and Jianchuan were all vital points. He asked to convert cavalry to infantry, add eight hundred troops, and post them at key passes. The border was then secured.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒，諡恪勤。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died; his posthumous title was Keqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died and was given the posthumous title Keqin.

sentences.zh: 烏大經，陝西長安人。

translations.literal: Wu Dajing was a native of Chang'an, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dajing came from Chang'an in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 由武進士授三等侍衛，出為山東德州營參將。

translations.literal: From military jinshi he was appointed Third Rank Bodyguard and went out as Dezhou Camp Vice Commander in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the military jinshi examination he was appointed a third-rank bodyguard and posted as vice commander of the Dezhou camp in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十九年，王倫倡亂，大經助守臨清，力戰保危城，功最多，高宗特獎之，立擢臨清副將。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year of Qianlong, when Wang Lun raised rebellion, Dajing helped defend Linqing, fought fiercely to preserve the endangered city, and had the greatest merit; Gaozong specially rewarded him and immediately promoted him to Linqing Vice Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year of Qianlong, when Wang Lun rebelled, Dajing helped defend Linqing and fought fiercely to save the endangered city. His merit was greatest, and Emperor Gaozong specially rewarded him with immediate promotion to vice commander at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 歷江西南贛鎮、貴州古州鎮總兵，廣西提督，調雲南。

translations.literal: He served successively as Nangan garrison commander of Jiangxi, Guzhou garrison commander of Guizhou, Guangxi provincial military commissioner, and was transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as garrison commander of Nangan in Jiangxi and Guzhou in Guizhou, then as provincial military commissioner of Guangxi, and was transferred to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 五十三年冬，率雲南兵從孫士毅徵安南，至則士毅已克其都城。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifty-third year he led Yunnan troops with Sun Shiyi to campaign in Annam; when he arrived Shiyi had already taken the enemy capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifty-third year he led Yunnan troops with Sun Shiyi against Annam. By the time he arrived, Shiyi had already captured the enemy capital.

sentences.zh: 明年春，大軍為阮惠所襲，敗績，大經所部得鄉導，全師而返。

translations.literal: The next spring the great army was attacked by Nguyen Hue and defeated; Dajing's division obtained local guides and returned with the whole force intact.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the main army was attacked by Nguyen Hue and defeated. Dajing's division found local guides and brought his whole force back intact.

sentences.zh: 尋母憂去職，起為甘肅提督，復調雲南。

translations.literal: Soon he left office for mourning on his mother, was recalled as Gansu provincial military commissioner, and again transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left office to mourn his mother, was recalled as provincial military commissioner of Gansu, and was transferred again to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，僧銅金與孟連土司構難，句結野倮，蔓延猛猛及緬寧內地，大經偕總兵蘇爾相進剿，克緬屬南柯、三節石、昔木、臘南、那招、霧籠、上中下寧安、臘東、困賽等地，破南灑河賊卡，肅清緬邊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing the monk Tongjin quarreled with the Menglian tusi, colluded with wild Luo, and the trouble spread through Mengmeng and the interior of Mianning; Dajing with Regional Commander Su Erxiang advanced to suppress them, took Nankou, Sanjieshi, Ximu, Lanan, Nazhao, Wulong, upper, middle, and lower Ning'an, Ladong, Kunsai, and other places under Burmese jurisdiction, broke the rebel checkpoint on Nansa River, and pacified the Burmese border.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiaqing the monk Tongjin clashed with the Menglian tusi, colluded with wild Luo tribes, and the unrest spread through Mengmeng and the interior of Mianning. Dajing joined regional commander Su Erxiang in a suppression campaign, captured Nankou, Sanjieshi, Ximu, Lanan, Nazhao, Wulong, the upper, middle, and lower Ning'an districts, Ladong, Kunsai, and other Burmese-held places, broke the rebel checkpoint on the Nansa River, and pacified the Burmese border.

sentences.zh: 署按察使屠述濂由猛猛一路會剿，連克大蚌山、南元寨。

translations.literal: Acting Provincial Judge Tu Shulian joined the suppression by the Mengmeng route and in succession took Dabang Mountain and Nanyuan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Acting provincial judge Tu Shulian joined the campaign along the Mengmeng route and in succession captured Dabang Mountain and Nanyuan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 五年春，總督書麟視師，用大經計，分兩路進攻猛白山箐，大經由南路，連戰渡黑河，焚賊寨，首逆尋就擒，夷眾受撫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year Governor-General Shulin inspected the army and used Dajing's plan to attack Mengbai Mountain Stockade by two routes; Dajing took the southern route, fought repeatedly across Hei River, burned rebel stockades, the chief rebel was soon captured, and the Yi submitted to pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year Governor-General Shulin inspected the army and adopted Dajing's plan to attack Mengbai Mountain Stockade from two directions. Dajing took the southern route, fought repeatedly across the Hei River, burned rebel stockades, and soon captured the chief rebel. The Yi then submitted.

sentences.zh: 七年春，入覲。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year he entered court audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year he went to the capital for audience.

sentences.zh: 會維西事起，命大經馳回，從琅玕進剿，大經偕總兵書成先清威遠倮匪，乃會兵維西，克康普。

translations.literal: When the Weixi affair arose he was ordered to hurry back; following Langgan in the advance, Dajing with Regional Commander Shu Cheng first cleared the Weiyuan Luo bandits, then united forces in Weixi and took Kangpu.
translations.idiomatic: When trouble broke out in Weixi he was ordered to hurry back. Following Langgan's advance, Dajing and regional commander Shu Cheng first cleared the Luo bandits at Weiyuan, then joined forces in Weixi and captured Kangpu.

sentences.zh: 上意不欲窮兵，命大經留防。

translations.literal: The emperor did not wish to pursue war to the limit and ordered Dajing to remain on defense.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not wish to pursue the war to the limit and ordered Dajing to remain on garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 及匪复肆掠，進剿獨村坪及康普、小維西，連克之。

translations.literal: When the bandits again plundered freely, he advanced to suppress Ducunping and Kangpu and Lesser Weixi, taking them in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels again began raiding, he advanced against Ducunping, Kangpu, and Lesser Weixi and captured them in succession.

sentences.zh: 八年春，與琅玕分駐石鼓、橋頭，沿江督剿，至十月，恆乍繃就擒，乃班師。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year he and Langgan garrisoned separately at Shigu and Qiaotou and supervised suppression along the river; by the tenth month Hengzhabeng was captured and the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year he and Langgan garrisoned separately at Shigu and Qiaotou and directed the campaign along the river. By the tenth month Hengzhabeng was captured and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died.

sentences.zh: 清安泰，費莫氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Qing Antai, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Antai, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十六年進士，授刑部主事，擢員外郎。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed a Ministry of Justice clerk, and promoted to Assistant Department Director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the forty-sixth year of Qianlong, entered the Ministry of Justice as a clerk, and was promoted to assistant department director.

sentences.zh: 出為甘肅涼州知府，調署蘭州，擢湖南衡永郴桂道。

translations.literal: He went out as Liangzhou prefect in Gansu, was transferred to act at Lanzhou, and promoted to Hunan Hengyong-Chengui Circuit Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as prefect of Liangzhou in Gansu, served temporarily at Lanzhou, and was promoted to intendant of the Hengyong-Chengui circuit in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六十年，苗疆事起，奉檄赴保靖撫輯降苗，以治餉功，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, when the Miao frontier affair arose, he received orders to go to Baojing to pacify surrendered Miao; for merit in managing provisions he was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year, when trouble broke out in the Miao frontier, he was ordered to Baojing to pacify surrendered Miao. For managing supplies well he was granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，械送首逆吳半生、石三保至京，擢按察使，遷廣西布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he escorted the chief rebels Wu Bansheng and Shi Sanbao to the capital in custody, was promoted to Provincial Judge, and transferred to Guangxi Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he escorted the chief rebels Wu Bansheng and Shi Sanbao to the capital under guard, was promoted to provincial judge, and transferred to administration commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 七年，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 八年，調浙江布政使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Zhejiang Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to administration commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢江西巡撫，調浙江。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Jiangxi governor and transferred to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to governor of Jiangxi and then transferred to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十一年，海寇蔡牽犯浙洋，赴溫、台防剿，嚴杜接濟，賊樵汲俱窮，竄去，詔褒之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the sea bandit Cai Qian raided Zhejiang waters; Antai went to Wenzhou and Taizhou to defend and suppress, strictly cut off supplies, until the bandits lacked fuel and water and fled; an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the pirate Cai Qian raided the waters off Zhejiang. Antai went to Wenzhou and Taizhou to organize defense and suppression, cut off supplies so strictly that the pirates lacked fuel and water, and drove them away. The court praised him.

sentences.zh: 總督阿林保劾提督李長庚因循玩寇，下清安泰密察，疏言：「長庚忠勇冠諸將，身先士卒，屢冒危險，為賊所畏。

translations.literal: Governor-General Alinbao impeached Provincial Military Commissioner Li Changgeng for procrastination and indulgence toward the bandits; the case was referred to Qing Antai for secret investigation, and he memorialized: 'Changgeng's loyalty and courage surpass all generals; he leads from the front, repeatedly braves danger, and is feared by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Alinbao impeached Provincial Military Commissioner Li Changgeng for dragging his feet against the pirates. The case was referred to Qing Antai for a secret investigation. He submitted a memorial: 'Changgeng's loyalty and courage surpass those of every other general. He leads from the front, repeatedly risks his life, and is feared by the pirates.

sentences.zh: 惟海艘越兩三旬若不燂洗，則苔黏旐結，駕駛不靈，其收港非逗留。

translations.literal: Only if a seagoing vessel goes more than twenty or thirty days without scraping and cleaning, barnacles and weeds adhere and the rigging fouls so that steering is sluggish; returning to port is not idling.
translations.idiomatic: But if a seagoing vessel goes twenty or thirty days without scraping and cleaning, barnacles and weeds foul the hull and rigging and make steering sluggish. Returning to port is not idling.

sentences.zh: 且海中勦賊，全憑風力，風勢不順，雖隔數十里猶數千里，旬日尚不能到。

translations.literal: Moreover, suppressing bandits at sea depends entirely on wind; if the wind is unfavorable, though separated by only several tens of li it is as several thousand li, and even ten days may not suffice to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, suppressing pirates at sea depends entirely on wind. If the wind is unfavorable, a distance of only a few tens of li becomes like several thousand li, and even ten days may not be enough to close the gap.

sentences.zh: 是故海上之兵，無風不戰，大風不戰，大雨不戰，逆風逆潮不戰，陰雲蒙霧不戰，日晚夜黑不戰，颶期將至，沙路不熟，賊眾我寡，前無泊地，皆不戰。

translations.literal: Therefore troops at sea do not fight without wind, in great wind, in heavy rain, against adverse wind or tide, in cloudy mist, at dusk or in darkness, when a typhoon season approaches, when sand channels are unfamiliar, when bandits are many and we few, or when there is no anchorage ahead: in all these they do not fight.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason naval forces do not fight without wind, in high wind, in heavy rain, against adverse wind or tide, in cloud and mist, at dusk or in darkness, when typhoon season is near, when sand channels are unfamiliar, when pirates outnumber them, or when there is no anchorage ahead.

sentences.zh: 及其戰也，勇力無所施，全以大砲轟擊，船身簸盪，中者幾何？

translations.literal: When they do fight, courage and strength have nowhere to apply; all relies on great-gun bombardment, yet the hull pitches and rolls—how many are hit?
translations.idiomatic: When they do fight, courage and physical strength count for little. Everything depends on cannon fire, yet as the hull pitches and rolls, how many shots actually find their mark?

sentences.zh: 我順風而逐，賊亦順風而逃，無伏可設，無險可扼，必以鉤鐮去其皮網，以大砲壞其舵身篷胎，使船傷行遲，我師環而攻之，賊窮投海，然後獲其一二船，而餘船已飄然遠矣。

translations.literal: We chase with the wind and the bandits also flee with the wind; there is no ambush to set, no pass to block; one must use hooked sickles to strip their leather nets and great guns to wreck rudder, hull, sail, and planking so the ship is damaged and slow; our fleet surrounds and attacks; the bandits in desperation cast themselves into the sea; only then do we take one or two ships while the rest are already far away.
translations.idiomatic: We chase with the wind, and the pirates flee with it as well. There is no place for an ambush and no choke point to hold. One must use hooked blades to strip their protective netting and heavy guns to wreck rudder, hull, sails, and planking so their ships are crippled and slow. Only then can our fleet surround and attack them. Even when some pirates throw themselves into the sea in desperation and we capture one or two ships, the rest are already far away.

sentences.zh: 賊往來三省數千里，皆沿海內洋。

translations.literal: The bandits travel several thousand li among three provinces, all within the coastal inner seas.
translations.idiomatic: The pirates ranged several thousand li across three provinces, all within the coastal inner seas.

sentences.zh: 其外洋灝瀚，則無船可掠，無嶴可依，從不敢往，惟遇剿急時始間為逋逃之​​地。

translations.literal: The outer ocean is vast; there are no ships to plunder and no coves to rely on, and they never dared go there, using it only occasionally as a place of escape when suppression grew urgent.
translations.idiomatic: The outer ocean is vast. There are no merchant ships to plunder and no coves to shelter in, so they never dared go there except occasionally as a refuge when suppression grew urgent.

sentences.zh: 倘日色西沉，賊直竄外洋，我師冒險無益，勢必回帆收港，而賊又逭誅矣。

translations.literal: If the sun sank in the west and the bandits fled straight to the outer ocean, our fleet would gain nothing by risking danger and would have to turn sail and enter port, and the bandits would again escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If the sun set and the pirates fled straight to the outer ocean, our fleet would gain nothing by taking risks and would have to return to port, and the pirates would escape again.

sentences.zh: 且船在大海之中，浪起如昇天，落如墜地，一物不固，即有覆溺之虞。

translations.literal: Moreover, when a ship is in the great sea, waves rise as if ascending to heaven and fall as if plunging to earth; if one thing is not secured there is risk of capsizing and drowning.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, on the open sea waves rise as if to heaven and fall as if to earth. If anything is not secured, the ship may capsize and drown its crew.

sentences.zh: 每遇大風，一舟折舵，全軍失色，雖賊在垂獲，亦必舍而收。

translations.literal: Whenever great wind came, if one vessel broke its rudder the whole force turned pale; even if bandits were on the verge of capture they had to abandon pursuit and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a great wind arose, if one vessel broke its rudder the whole force was shaken. Even when pirates were on the verge of capture, the fleet had to abandon pursuit and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 洎易桅竣工，賊已遠遁。

translations.literal: By the time the mast was replaced and the work finished, the bandits had already fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the mast was replaced, the pirates had already fled far away.

sentences.zh: 數日追及，桅壞复然，故常屢月不獲一戰。

translations.literal: After several days of pursuit they caught up, the mast broke again, and thus they often went many months without winning a battle.
translations.idiomatic: After several days they caught up, the mast broke again, and so they often went months without winning a battle.

sentences.zh: 夫船者，官兵之城郭、營壘、車馬也。

translations.literal: For troops, ships are city walls, camps, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: For naval forces, ships are city walls, camps, and horses.

sentences.zh: 船誠得力，以戰則勇，以守則固，以追則速，以沖則堅。

translations.literal: If ships are truly effective, they make fighting brave, defense firm, pursuit swift, and ramming solid.
translations.idiomatic: If ships are truly effective, they make fighting bold, defense firm, pursuit swift, and ramming powerful.

sentences.zh: 今浙省兵船皆長庚督造，頗能如式。

translations.literal: Now Zhejiang military vessels were all built under Changgeng's supervision and largely met the standard.
translations.idiomatic: The military vessels of Zhejiang were all built under Changgeng's supervision and largely met the standard.

sentences.zh: 惟兵船有定制，而閩省商船無定制，一報被劫，則商船即為賊船，愈高大多砲多糧，則愈足資寇。

translations.literal: Only military vessels had fixed regulations, while Fujian merchant vessels had none; once a robbery was reported, merchant ships became pirate ships, and the taller, larger, better-armed, and better-provisioned they were, the more they supplied the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Military vessels had fixed regulations, but Fujian merchant vessels did not. Once a robbery was reported, a merchant ship became a pirate ship. The taller, larger, better-armed, and better-provisioned it was, the more useful it was to the pirates.

sentences.zh: 近日長庚勦賊，使諸鎮之兵隔斷賊黨之船。

translations.literal: Recently in suppressing bandits Changgeng used troops from the various garrisons to cut off the bandit faction's vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, in suppressing the pirates, Changgeng used troops from the various garrisons to cut off the pirates' vessels from one another.

sentences.zh: 但以隔斷為功，不以擒獲為功。

translations.literal: But merit was measured by cutting off contact, not by capture.
translations.idiomatic: But merit was measured by cutting them off, not by capturing them.

sentences.zh: 而長庚自以己兵專注蔡逆坐船圍攻，賊行與行，賊止與止。

translations.literal: Changgeng himself concentrated his troops on besieging the rebel Cai's flagship: when the bandits moved he moved, when they halted he halted.
translations.idiomatic: Changgeng himself concentrated his own forces on besieging the rebel leader Cai's flagship: when the pirates moved he moved, and when they halted he halted.

sentences.zh: 無如賊船愈大砲愈多，是以兵士明知盜船貨財充積，而不能為擒賊擒王之計。

translations.literal: Yet the bandit ships grew ever larger and carried ever more guns, so that though the soldiers knew the pirate ships were laden with goods and wealth, they could not carry out the plan of capturing the bandits and seizing their leader.
translations.idiomatic: But the pirate ships grew ever larger and carried ever more guns, so that although the soldiers knew those ships were laden with loot, they could not carry out a plan to capture the pirates and their leader.

sentences.zh: 且水陸兵餉，例止發三月。

translations.literal: Moreover, land and sea military pay was issued by regulation for only three months.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, military pay for land and sea forces was issued by regulation for only three months at a time.

sentences.zh: 海洋路遠，往返稽時，而事機之來，間不容髮，遲之一日，雖勞費經年，不足追其前效。

translations.literal: Ocean routes are distant and round trips consume time, yet when opportunity comes it allows no interval; delay one day and even a year's labor and expense cannot recover the earlier effect.
translations.idiomatic: Ocean routes are long and round trips consume time, yet when opportunity comes there is no room for delay. Lose one day and even a year's labor and expense cannot recover what was lost.

sentences.zh: 此皆已往之積弊也。

translations.literal: These are all accumulated abuses of the past.
translations.idiomatic: These were all accumulated abuses of the past.

sentences.zh: 非盡矯從前之失，不能收將來之效；

translations.literal: Unless past errors are fully corrected, future results cannot be gained;
translations.idiomatic: Unless past errors were fully corrected, future results could not be gained;

sentences.zh: 非使賊盡失其所長，亦無由攻其所短。

translations.literal: unless the bandits are made to lose all their strengths, there is no way to attack their weaknesses.
translations.idiomatic: unless the pirates were stripped of their advantages, there was no way to attack their weaknesses.

sentences.zh: 則岸姦濟賊之禁，必宜兩省合力，乃可期效。

translations.literal: then prohibitions on shore collaborators aiding bandits must be enforced by the two provinces acting together before results can be expected.
translations.idiomatic: Then prohibitions on shore collaborators aiding the pirates had to be enforced jointly by the two provinces before results could be expected.

sentences.zh: 」奏上，詔嘉其公正。

translations.literal: ' The memorial was submitted and an edict praised his fairness.
translations.idiomatic: ' The memorial was submitted, and an edict praised his fairness.

sentences.zh: 由是益鄉用長庚，清安泰之力也。

translations.literal: From this the court increasingly relied on Changgeng, through Qing Antai's effort.
translations.idiomatic: From this the court came to rely on Changgeng even more, thanks to Qing Antai's intervention.

sentences.zh: 尋又條上防海事宜：「沿海居民，編造保甲。

translations.literal: He soon also submitted items on coastal defense: 'Coastal residents should be organized into baojia units.
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted further proposals on coastal defense: 'Coastal residents should be organized into baojia units.

sentences.zh: 稽覈商販，以斷米糧出口；

translations.literal: Merchants should be inspected and verified to cut off grain exports;
translations.idiomatic: Merchants should be inspected to cut off grain exports;

sentences.zh: 禁制火爆，防火藥透漏；

translations.literal: fireworks should be restricted to prevent gunpowder from leaking out;
translations.idiomatic: fireworks should be restricted to prevent gunpowder from leaking out;

sentences.zh: 斷絕採捕，以杜姦宄溷跡。

translations.literal: fishing and gathering should be cut off to block traitors from mingling in disguise.
translations.idiomatic: and fishing and gathering should be curtailed to keep collaborators from mingling unnoticed.

sentences.zh: 」並如議行。

translations.literal: ' All were implemented as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: ' All were implemented as he proposed.

sentences.zh: 十二年冬，蔡牽子至普陀寺，未獲，被譴責。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twelfth year Cai Qian's son reached Putuo Temple but was not captured, and Antai was rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twelfth year Cai Qian's son reached Putuo Temple but was not captured, and Antai was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 尋以阮元代之，調河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon Ruan Yuan replaced him and he was transferred to Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ruan Yuan replaced him, and he was transferred to governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 常明，佟佳氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Chang Ming, of the Tunggiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ming, of the Tunggiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 由筆帖式授步軍統領主事，出為湖南桂陽知州，擢雲南曲靖知府。

translations.literal: From clerical secretary he was appointed a Metropolitan Garrison clerk, went out as Guiyang prefect in Hunan, and was promoted to Qujing prefect in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a clerical secretary, he was appointed a clerk in the Metropolitan Garrison, posted as prefect of Guiyang in Hunan, and promoted to prefect of Qujing in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六十年，從總督福康安徵苗疆，率​​兵屢克賊巢，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year of Qianlong he followed Governor-General Fuk'anggan to campaign in the Miao frontier, led troops in repeated captures of rebel nests, and was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year of Qianlong he followed Governor-General Fuk'anggan against the Miao frontier, led troops in repeated captures of rebel strongholds, and was granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 鎮筸苗吳半生據蘇麻寨，自構皮寨進擊敗之，复破西梁賊砦，擢貴州貴東道。

translations.literal: The Zhenxiong Miao Wu Bansheng held Sumazhai; Ming built a leather stockade and advanced to defeat him, then again broke the Xiliang rebel fort and was promoted to Guizhou Guidong Circuit Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenxiong Miao leader Wu Bansheng held Sumazhai. Ming built a leather stockade and advanced to defeat him, then broke the rebel fort at Xiliang and was promoted to intendant of the Guidong circuit in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 掩擊半生於板登寨，獲其弟吳老正等，半生復來犯，設伏大破之，乘勝奪賊卡五；

translations.literal: He ambushed Bansheng at Bandeng Stockade and captured his brother Wu Laozheng and others; Bansheng attacked again and Ming set an ambush that broke him severely, then seized five rebel checkpoints in the pursuit;
translations.idiomatic: He ambushed Bansheng at Bandeng Stockade and captured his brother Wu Laozheng and others. When Bansheng attacked again, Ming set an ambush and routed him, then seized five rebel checkpoints in the pursuit;

sentences.zh: 尋由西梁進攻，毀其寨，賊糾夯柳苗為援，殲戮甚眾；

translations.literal: he then advanced from Xiliang, destroyed their stockade, the rebels rallied Hangliu Miao as aid, and very many were killed;
translations.idiomatic: he then advanced from Xiliang, destroyed their stockade, and when the rebels rallied Hangliu Miao as reinforcements, killed a great many of them;

sentences.zh: 乞降，拒不受，復大挫之：擢按察使，賜號智勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: they begged to surrender but he refused; he again broke them severely: he was promoted to Provincial Judge and granted the title Valiant and Wise Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: They begged to surrender, but he refused and routed them again. He was promoted to provincial judge and granted the title Valiant and Wise Batulu.

sentences.zh: 詔以苗匪每遇敗乞降，叵測難信，飭各路將領以常明為法。

translations.literal: An edict noted that Miao bandits often begged surrender after defeat, which was unpredictable and hard to trust, and ordered commanders on all routes to take Chang Ming as their model.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Miao rebels often sued for surrender after defeat, which was unpredictable and untrustworthy, and ordered commanders on all routes to follow Chang Ming's example.

sentences.zh: 進剿老烏廠，斬賊目隴老香，與總兵珠隆阿合剿大烏草河迤西苗，連克魚井、豆田三十餘寨。

translations.literal: He advanced to suppress Laowuchang, beheaded the bandit leader Long Laoxiang, and with Regional Commander Zhulong'a jointly suppressed the Miao west of Dawucao River, taking in succession more than thirty stockades including Yujing and Doutian.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against Laowuchang, beheaded the rebel leader Long Laoxiang, and with regional commander Zhulong'a jointly suppressed the Miao west of the Dawucao River, capturing more than thirty stockades including Yujing and Doutian.

sentences.zh: 會大軍於古丈坪，半生適至，常明冒雨進攻，殲賊千餘；

translations.literal: He joined the great army at Guzhangping; Bansheng happened to arrive and Chang Ming attacked in the rain, destroying more than a thousand bandits;
translations.idiomatic: He joined the main army at Guzhangping. Bansheng happened to arrive, and Chang Ming attacked in the rain, killing more than a thousand rebels;

sentences.zh: 分兵克烏龍巖、茶它山諸寨卡，進圍高多寨，半生降，乘銳克鴨保寨。

translations.literal: he divided troops to take Wulongyan, Chata Mountain, and other stockade checkpoints, advanced to surround Gaoduo Stockade, Bansheng surrendered, and riding the momentum he took Yabao Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: he divided his forces to take Wulongyan, Chata Mountain, and other stockade checkpoints, advanced to surround Gaoduo Stockade, accepted Bansheng's surrender, and while the army's momentum was high captured Yabao Stockade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，剿下平隴苗於葫蘆坪，母憂，留營，偕副將海格破小竹山賊於墮河坡，俘賊目楊通等。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he suppressed the Xiapinglong Miao at Huluoping; during mourning for his mother he remained at camp and with Vice Commander Haige broke the Xiaozhushan bandits at Duohepo, capturing the bandit leader Yang Tong and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing he suppressed the Xiapinglong Miao at Huluoping. While mourning his mother he remained with the army and, with vice commander Haige, defeated the Xiaozhushan rebels at Duohepo and captured the rebel leader Yang Tong and others.

sentences.zh: 上嘉常明奮勉，仍命署按察使。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Chang Ming's exertion and still ordered him to act as Provincial Judge.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Chang Ming's exertion and still ordered him to serve as acting provincial judge.

sentences.zh: 二年春，貴州仲苗起，從總督勒保討之，與施縉並為軍鋒，同破賊關嶺，复夾攻，連拔賊寨八，解新城圍，再敗之望城坡。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year the secondary Miao of Guizhou rose; he followed Governor-General Lebao to suppress them, shared the army's spearhead with Shi Jin, together broke the rebel Guanling, again attacked from both sides, took eight rebel stockades in succession, relieved the siege of Xincheng, and again defeated them at Wangchengpo.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year the secondary Miao of Guizhou rose. He followed Governor-General Lebao to suppress them and, with Shi Jin, served as the army's spearhead. Together they broke through at Guanling, attacked from both sides, captured eight rebel stockades in succession, lifted the siege of Xincheng, and defeated the rebels again at Wangchengpo.

sentences.zh: 賊匿岩洞以拒，設伏，斃賊千餘，環攻於卡子河，賊大潰，解南籠圍，加布政使銜。

translations.literal: The rebels hid in rock caves to resist; he set an ambush and killed more than a thousand, surrounded and attacked at Kazi River, the rebels collapsed in great disorder, the siege of Nanlong was relieved, and he was given Provincial Administration Commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels hid in rock caves to resist. He set an ambush and killed more than a thousand, surrounded them at the Kazi River, routed them completely, lifted the siege of Nanlong, and was granted administration commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 時黃草壩被圍久，滇、黔道梗，常明援之，克九頭山，獲偽將軍陸寶貴，毀馬鞭田賊柵，俘李阿六等，連戰皆捷，圍乃解。

translations.literal: At the time Huangcaoba had long been besieged and the Yunnan-Guizhou routes were blocked; Chang Ming went to its aid, took Jiutou Mountain, captured the false general Lu Baogui, destroyed the rebel barrier at Mabiantian, captured Li A'liu and others, won successive battles, and the siege was then lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Huangcaoba had long been besieged and the routes between Yunnan and Guizhou were blocked. Chang Ming went to its relief, captured Jiutou Mountain, seized the false general Lu Baogui, destroyed the rebel barrier at Mabiantian, captured Li A'liu and others, won battle after battle, and lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 尋克馬鞍山，繞擊洞灑賊巢，連攻三晝夜，擒賊酋吳抱仙於三隴口，授布政使。

translations.literal: Soon he took Ma'anshan, swung around to strike the Dongsa rebel nest, attacked for three days and nights in succession, captured the rebel chief Wu Baoxian at Sanlongkou, and was appointed Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he captured Ma'anshan, swung around to strike the Dongsa rebel nest, attacked for three days and nights, captured the rebel chief Wu Baoxian at Sanlongkou, and was appointed administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 進克安有山，搗當丈賊巢，獲逆首韋七綹須，又擒賊目黃阿金、梁國珍等於補衲山。

translations.literal: He advanced to take Anyou Mountain, stormed the Dangzhang rebel nest, captured the rebel leader Wei Qixuxu, and also seized the bandit leaders Huang Ajin and Liang Guozhen and others at Bunashan.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to take Anyou Mountain, stormed the Dangzhang rebel nest, captured the rebel leader Wei Qixuxu, and also seized the rebel officers Huang Ajin and Liang Guozhen and others at Bunashan.

sentences.zh: 三年，連拔雨薛岩等十八寨，苗境悉平。

translations.literal: In the third year he took in succession eighteen stockades including Yuxueyan, and the Miao region was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he captured eighteen stockades including Yuxueyan in succession, and the Miao region was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 服闋，始蒞布政使任。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he first assumed the Provincial Administration Commissionership.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended he formally took up the administration commissionership.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，署巡撫，疏薦總兵施縉率貴州兵赴四川剿教匪。

translations.literal: That winter he acted as governor and memorialized recommending Regional Commander Shi Jin to lead Guizhou troops to Sichuan to suppress the sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he served as acting governor and recommended regional commander Shi Jin to lead Guizhou troops to Sichuan to suppress the sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 五年，因縉戰歿，貴州兵不能救，常明坐褫翎頂。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because Jin died in battle and Guizhou troops could not rescue him, Chang Ming was punished by stripping his feather and insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, because Jin died in battle and Guizhou troops failed to rescue him, Chang Ming was stripped of his feather and insignia.

sentences.zh: 秋，入覲，詔念前勞，予三品頂帶，留巡撫署任。

translations.literal: In autumn he entered audience; an edict, mindful of his earlier service, granted third-rank insignia and kept him in the acting governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he went to the capital for audience. Mindful of his earlier service, the court granted him third-rank insignia and kept him in the acting governorship.

sentences.zh: 題銷軍需，詔詰貴陽賊踪未至，募鄉勇多至五萬餘名，用銀十九萬餘兩，命總督琅玕察覈。

translations.literal: In settling military accounts an edict questioned why rebel tracks had not reached Guiyang though militia recruited reached more than fifty thousand and more than 190,000 taels were spent; Governor-General Langgan was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When he settled military accounts, an edict questioned why rebel tracks had not reached Guiyang even though more than fifty thousand militiamen had been recruited at a cost of more than 190,000 taels. Governor-General Langgan was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 尋奏常明雖無冒帑，處置失宜，責賠繳賞卹銀九萬餘兩。
