translations.literal: Soon he memorialized that though Chang Ming had not embezzled funds, his handling was improper, and he was ordered to pay back more than ninety thousand taels in rewards and condolence silver.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan soon reported that although Chang Ming had not embezzled funds, he had handled matters improperly and was ordered to repay more than ninety thousand taels in rewards and condolence payments.

sentences.zh: 六年，石峴苗與湖南苗句結為亂，巡撫伊桑阿檄常明率師攻克之，復原銜、花翎，尋授巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Shixian Miao joined with Hunan Miao bands in rebellion; Governor Yisang'a ordered Chang Ming to lead troops and capture them; his original rank and peacock feather were restored, and he was soon appointed governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Shixian Miao allied with Hunan Miao rebels. Governor Yisang'a ordered Chang Ming to lead troops against them and take them. His original rank and peacock feather were restored, and he was soon appointed governor.

sentences.zh: 七年，以挪用鉛廠帑銀，及失察幕僚私售鉛丸，抽匿案卷事，褫職，籍沒家產。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, for misappropriating treasury silver from the lead factory and for failing to detect that staff secretly sold lead pellets and concealed case documents, he was stripped of office and his household property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was stripped of office and his property confiscated for misappropriating lead-factory treasury funds and for failing to detect that his staff secretly sold lead pellets and concealed case documents.

sentences.zh: 既而予藍翎侍衛，充伊犁領隊大臣，調庫車辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Later he was granted the blue-lantern guard attendant post, appointed deputy commandant at Yili, and transferred to resident commissioner at Kuqa.
translations.idiomatic: He was later made a blue-lantern guard attendant, appointed Yili deputy commandant, and transferred to resident commissioner at Kuqa.

sentences.zh: 十年，授湖北鹽法道，累遷湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Hubei salt commissioner and was promoted in succession to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed Hubei salt commissioner and rose in succession to Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 上念常明久於軍事，以四川民、夷雜處，控制不易，十五年，特擢為總督，詔勉其盡職，減免賠項銀萬五千兩。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful that Chang Ming had long served in military affairs and that Sichuan's mixed Han and Yi population was hard to control, in the fifteenth year specially promoted him to governor-general, exhorted him to fulfill his duties, and remitted 15,000 taels of indemnity silver.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Chang Ming's long military service and of how hard it was to control Sichuan's mixed Han and Yi population, the emperor in the fifteenth year promoted him to governor-general, urged him to do his duty, and remitted 15,000 taels of indemnity.

sentences.zh: 寧遠府屬夷地，多募漢人充佃，自教匪之亂，川民避入者增至數十萬人，爭端漸起。

translations.literal: In Yi territory under Ningyuan Prefecture many Han were hired as tenant farmers; since the sect rebellion Han refugees entering reached several hundred thousand and disputes gradually arose.
translations.idiomatic: In Yi areas under Ningyuan Prefecture many Han were hired as tenants. After the sect rebellion Han refugees there grew to several hundred thousand, and disputes gradually multiplied.

sentences.zh: 十七年，常明疏請：「漢民移居夷地及佃種者，編查入冊，不追既往。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Chang Ming memorialized: 'Han who have moved into Yi lands and those who lease fields should be registered in books without punishing the past.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Chang Ming memorialized: 'Han settlers in Yi territory and tenant farmers should be entered in registers without retroactive punishment.

sentences.zh: 此後嚴禁夷人招佃與漢民轉佃，並編​​保甲以資約束，增文員以便彈壓，移營汛以利控制。

translations.literal: Henceforth strictly forbid Yi from recruiting tenants and Han from sub-leasing; also organize baojia for restraint, add civil officials for suppression, and shift garrison posts for control.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Yi recruiting tenants and Han sub-leasing must be strictly forbidden; baojia should be organized for restraint, more civil officials added for suppression, and garrison posts shifted to improve control.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: ' Approved.
translations.idiomatic: ' The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 又請川省鹽課改歸地丁，聽民興販，詔斥其妨礙淮綱，不顧鄰省利害，降二級留任。

translations.literal: He also asked that Sichuan salt duties be folded into land tax and that the people be allowed free trade; an edict rebuked him for obstructing the Huai salt monopoly and disregarding neighboring provinces' interests, and he was demoted two ranks but kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to fold Sichuan salt levies into the land tax and allow free private trade. An edict rebuked him for obstructing the Huai salt monopoly and ignoring neighboring provinces, and he was demoted two ranks but kept in post.

sentences.zh: 十八年，署成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he acted as Chengdu regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he served as acting Chengdu regional commander.

sentences.zh: 二十年，中瞻對番酋洛布七力為亂，偕提​​督多隆阿、總兵羅思舉往剿，自里塘進攻，破之，搗熱籠賊巢，洛布七力舉家焚斃。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Zhongzan Tibetan chief Lob Chilha rebelled; together with Provincial Military Commissioner Duolong'a and Regional Commander Luo Siju he went to suppress them, advancing from Litang, defeating them, storming the Hot Nest rebel lair, and Lob Chilha's whole family burned to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Zhongzan Tibetan chief Lob Chilha rebelled. With provincial military commissioner Duolong'a and regional commander Luo Siju he marched to suppress them, advanced from Litang, broke them, stormed the Hot Nest rebel lair, and Lob Chilha's entire family perished in the flames.

sentences.zh: 詔以未生得逆首，不予議敘。

translations.literal: An edict said that because the rebel leader was not captured alive, no reward of merit was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because the rebel leader was not taken alive, no merit reward was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，成都革兵謀變，悉捕之置於法，詔嘉其鎮靜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Chengdu garrison soldiers plotted mutiny; he arrested them all and punished them by law; an edict praised his calm handling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Chengdu garrison soldiers plotted mutiny. He arrested them all and punished them by law, and an edict praised his firm handling.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，寧越夷擾邊，遣將平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Ningyue Yi disturbed the border; he sent generals to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Ningyue Yi raided the frontier; he sent troops to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子少保，優恤，諡襄恪。

translations.literal: Soon he died; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, favored condolence payments, and given the posthumous name Xiangke.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with favored condolence payments and the posthumous name Xiangke.

sentences.zh: 溫承惠，字景僑，山西太谷人。

translations.literal: Wen Chenghui, courtesy name Jingqiao, was a native of Taigu in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Chenghui, courtesy name Jingqiao, came from Taigu in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年拔貢，朝考首擢，除七品小京官，分吏部。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Qianlong he passed the provincial tribute examination; in the palace examination he was placed first in promotion and appointed a seventh-rank junior capital official in the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 42 he passed the provincial tribute examination, topped the palace examination promotions, and was appointed a seventh-rank junior capital official in the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 拔貢內用自是始。

translations.literal: Appointment of tribute scholars to the capital service began from this.
translations.idiomatic: This was when tribute scholars first began to be appointed within the capital service.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to director.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，出為陝西督糧道，母憂歸。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he went out as Shaanxi grain transport commissioner and returned home on his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In year 54 he became Shaanxi grain transport commissioner, then returned home for his mother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 高宗巡幸五台，迎鑾召對，嘉其才。

translations.literal: When Gaozong toured Wutai he was summoned to audience on welcoming the imperial procession and praised for his talent.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong toured Wutai, Wen was summoned to audience while welcoming the imperial procession and praised for his ability.

sentences.zh: 服闋，補延榆綏道。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed Yan-Yu-Sui commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he was appointed Yan-Yu-Sui commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，川、陝、楚軍事急，承惠奉檄治興安、漢中團防。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing military affairs in Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei were urgent; Chenghui received orders to organize militia defense in Xing'an and Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing year 1, with war urgent in Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei, Chenghui was ordered to organize militia defense in Xing'an and Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 遭父憂，留軍，仍攝道事。

translations.literal: His father died; he remained with the army and still acted as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he stayed with the army and continued to act as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 賊犯平利，承惠馳剿，山水猝漲，墜水，遇救得免。

translations.literal: When rebels invaded Pingli, Chenghui rushed to suppress them; mountain floods suddenly rose and he fell into the water but was rescued.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels struck Pingli, Chenghui rushed to suppress them. A sudden mountain flood swept him into the water, but he was rescued.

sentences.zh: 趨扼險隘，獲捷。

translations.literal: He hurried to hold the strategic pass and won a victory.
translations.idiomatic: He hurried to seize the strategic pass and won a victory.

sentences.zh: 服闋，命以按察使銜仍補原官。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was ordered to resume his former post with administration commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was ordered to resume his former post with administration commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢陝西按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted Shaanxi administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted Shaanxi administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「賊擾陝境，已歷數年。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'Rebels have disturbed Shaanxi for several years already.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: 'Rebels have disturbed Shaanxi for several years.

sentences.zh: 兵為牽綴，運餉往往不及。

translations.literal: Troops are tied down and transport of provisions often cannot keep up.
translations.idiomatic: Troops are tied down and supplies often fail to arrive in time.

sentences.zh: 則駐兵以待，賊得乘間遠逸。

translations.literal: Then troops are stationed to wait, and rebels seize the interval to flee far away.
translations.idiomatic: Forces then camp and wait while rebels slip away in the interval.

sentences.zh: 三省邊境綿長，宜扼要駐兵，以逸待勞。

translations.literal: The three provinces' long borders should have troops stationed at key points to meet fatigue with leisure.
translations.idiomatic: Along the three provinces' long borders, troops should hold key points and meet fatigue with leisure.

sentences.zh: 」上韙之。

translations.literal: ' The emperor approved it.
translations.idiomatic: ' The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 殲匪首王金柱於安康，复破賊洵陽，賑撫流亡，民心漸定。

translations.literal: He destroyed the bandit chief Wang Jinzhu at Ankang, again defeated rebels at Xunyang, relieved and settled refugees, and popular sentiment gradually stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed bandit chief Wang Jinzhu at Ankang, again defeated rebels at Xunyang, relieved refugees, and popular sentiment gradually settled.

sentences.zh: 遷布政使，仍留防。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial treasurer but still remained on defense duty.
translations.idiomatic: He was made provincial treasurer but remained on defense duty.

sentences.zh: 賊屢犯境，輒擊卻之。

translations.literal: Whenever rebels repeatedly invaded the border he drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever rebels raided the border he drove them back.

sentences.zh: 守禦興、漢先後凡六年，事定優敘。

translations.literal: He guarded Xing'an and Hanzhong for six years in all; when affairs were settled he received preferential merit rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He guarded Xing'an and Hanzhong for six years in all; when the crisis ended he received preferential merit rewards.

sentences.zh: 八年，調河南，修伊、洛舊渠。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Henan and repaired the old canals of the Yi and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to Henan and repaired the old Yi and Luo canals.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢江西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調福建，兼署總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Fujian and also acted as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Fujian and also acted as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 海寇蔡牽犯台灣鹿耳門，檄總兵許松年赴海壇、竿塘與提督李長庚會剿，三沙為蔡牽鄉里，增兵駐守，禁沿海接濟，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Sea bandit Cai Qian attacked Taiwan's Luermen; he ordered Regional Commander Xu Songnian to go to Haitan and Gandang to join Provincial Military Commissioner Li Changgeng in joint suppression; Sansha was Cai Qian's home region so troops were increased to garrison it and coastal aid to the rebels was forbidden; an edict praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Sea bandit Cai Qian attacked Taiwan's Luermen. He ordered regional commander Xu Songnian to Haitan and Gandang to join provincial military commissioner Li Changgeng in joint suppression. Because Sansha was Cai Qian's home region he increased garrison troops and forbade coastal aid to the rebels; an edict praised this.

sentences.zh: 尋調署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to act as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，上閱古北口兵，獎其嫺整，命實授。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor reviewed troops at Gubeikou, praised their drill and order, and ordered substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor reviewed troops at Gubeikou, praised their drill and order, and confirmed his substantive appointment.

sentences.zh: 濬黑龍、溫榆、北運、滏陽諸河。

translations.literal: He dredged the Heilong, Wenyu, Beiyun, and Fuyang rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged the Heilong, Wenyu, Beiyun, and Fuyang rivers.

sentences.zh: 十三年，上幸天津，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year when the emperor visited Tianjin he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, when the emperor visited Tianjin, he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 尋以巡幸點景科派，為肥鄉令所揭，褫花翎、黃馬褂，旋復之。

translations.literal: Soon because of scenic-point levies on imperial tours exposed by the Feixiang magistrate, his peacock feather and yellow jacket were stripped, then soon restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because scenic-point levies on imperial tours were exposed by the Feixiang magistrate, his peacock feather and yellow jacket were stripped, then soon restored.

sentences.zh: 十七年正月，以歲除得雪，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventeenth year, because snow fell at New Year's, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventeenth year, because snow fell at New Year's, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 鉅鹿縣民孫維儉等傳習大乘教，灤州民董懷信傳習金丹、八卦教，先後發覺，失察輕縱，褫宮銜、花翎、黃馬褂，革職留任。

translations.literal: The Juxian commoner Sun Weijian and others propagated the Mahayana teaching, and Luanzhou commoner Dong Huaixin propagated the Golden Elixir and Eight Trigrams teachings; when these were discovered in succession he was punished for lax detection and light handling by stripping palace rank, peacock feather, and yellow jacket and being dismissed but kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: When Juxian commoner Sun Weijian propagated the Mahayana teaching and Luanzhou commoner Dong Huaixin propagated the Golden Elixir and Eight Trigrams teachings, he was punished for lax detection and lenient handling: palace rank, peacock feather, and yellow jacket were stripped and he was dismissed but kept in office.

sentences.zh: 復以他事數被譴責。

translations.literal: Again on other matters he was several times rebuked and punished.
translations.idiomatic: He was several times rebuked and punished on other matters as well.

sentences.zh: 十八年，河南滑縣教匪起，命偕提督馬瑜往剿，數戰滑縣近地，破賊於道口。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year sect rebels rose in Huaxian, Henan; he was ordered to join Provincial Military Commissioner Ma Yu in suppression and after several battles near Huaxian broke the rebels at Daokou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year sect rebels rose in Huaxian, Henan. He was ordered to join provincial military commissioner Ma Yu in suppression and, after several battles near Huaxian, broke them at Daokou.

sentences.zh: 尋命陝甘總督那彥成總統軍務，承惠為參贊。

translations.literal: Soon Governor-General Nayancheng of Shaanxi-Gansu was ordered to command overall military affairs with Chenghui as staff adviser.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Nayancheng was ordered to command overall military affairs with Chenghui as staff adviser.

sentences.zh: 時匪首林清在京師起事，擾及宮禁，詔以林清傳教八年，承惠不能先事查緝，及剿匪逗留罪，褫職，留治糧餉。

translations.literal: At the time rebel chief Lin Qing rose in the capital, disturbing even the palace precincts; an edict said Lin Qing had propagated his teaching for eight years and Chenghui had failed to investigate beforehand, and also punished him for delay in suppressing rebels; he was stripped of office but kept to manage provisions.
translations.idiomatic: When rebel chief Lin Qing rose in the capital and disturbed even the palace precincts, an edict said Lin Qing had taught for eight years while Chenghui failed to investigate in advance, and also punished his delay in suppression; he was stripped of office but kept to manage provisions.

sentences.zh: 十九年，命以員外郎赴河南睢工效力，工竣，遷郎中，隨尚書戴均元襄理永定河工。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was ordered to go to Henan Suigong works as an outer-court official; when the works ended he was promoted director and followed Minister Dai Junyuan in managing Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was ordered to Henan Suigong works as an outer-court official. When the works ended he was promoted director and followed minister Dai Junyuan on Yongding River works.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授山東按察使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Shandong administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Shandong administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 承惠前官畿輔，不孚眾望，及復起，頗思晚蓋。

translations.literal: Chenghui's earlier service in the capital region had not won public confidence; on returning to office he greatly wished to redeem his reputation in later years.
translations.idiomatic: His earlier service in the capital region had not won confidence; on returning to office he greatly wished to redeem his reputation.

sentences.zh: 山東故多盜，偵知東平人廣平知府王兆奎三世窩盜，密捕治之，期年積案一清。

translations.literal: Shandong had long had many bandits; he learned that Wang Zhaoqi, prefect of Guangping in Dongping, had harbored bandits for three generations and secretly arrested and punished them; within a year accumulated cases were all cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had long been bandit-ridden. Learning that Dongping native Wang Zhaoqi, prefect of Guangping, had harbored bandits for three generations, he secretly arrested and punished them, and within a year accumulated cases were cleared.

sentences.zh: 掊擊貪酷，蘇困起敝，吏治為之一變，特詔褒獎，然卒不安其位。

translations.literal: He struck down the greedy and cruel, relieved distress and revived the exhausted, and official conduct changed entirely; a special edict praised him, yet in the end he could not keep his post.
translations.idiomatic: He struck down the greedy and cruel, relieved distress and revived the exhausted, and official conduct changed entirely. A special edict praised him, yet he could not keep his post.

sentences.zh: 先是盜夜劫泰安富民徐文誥家，戕其傭柏永柱，縣以誤殺為文誥罪，實疑獄也。

translations.literal: Earlier bandits had raided by night the house of the wealthy Taian commoner Xu Wengao, killing his servant Bai Yongzhu; the county treated it as accidental killing and convicted Wengao—a case that was in fact doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier bandits had raided by night the Taian wealthy commoner Xu Wengao's house and killed his servant Bai Yongzhu. The county convicted Wengao of accidental killing—a case that was in fact doubtful.

sentences.zh: 按察使程國仁入其言，鍛鍊定讞，承惠至，固疑不實，於他獄盜供得其情，銳意平反。

translations.literal: Administration Commissioner Cheng Guoren accepted his story, forged evidence and fixed the verdict; when Chenghui arrived he firmly doubted its truth, and from another bandit case obtained the facts and was determined to reverse the judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Administration commissioner Cheng Guoren accepted the county's account, forged evidence, and fixed the verdict. When Chenghui arrived he firmly doubted it, learned the truth from another bandit case, and was determined to reverse the judgment.

sentences.zh: 巡撫和舜武惑於浮言，尼之。

translations.literal: Governor Heshunwu was misled by loose talk and obstructed him.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Heshunwu was misled by loose talk and obstructed him.

sentences.zh: 及偵獲盜首王壯於吉林，具承槍殺永柱狀。

translations.literal: When the bandit chief Wang Zhuang was captured in Jilin and fully confessed to shooting Yongzhu with a gun.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandit chief Wang Zhuang was captured in Jilin and fully confessed to shooting Yongzhu.

sentences.zh: 時國仁已擢巡撫，舊與承惠有嫌，且護前，不欲承惠竟是獄，檄勘堤工，承惠辭，乃劾承惠自以曾官總督，橫肆不受節制，褫職，薦前兗沂道童槐繼為按察使。

translations.literal: By then Guoren had been promoted governor; he had old enmity with Chenghui and, protecting his earlier position, did not want Chenghui to settle this case; he ordered Chenghui to inspect dike works; Chenghui declined; then he impeached Chenghui for acting high-handedly as a former governor-general and refusing control, stripped him of office, and recommended former Yan-Yi commissioner Tong Huai to succeed as administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: By then Guoren had been promoted governor. He had old enmity with Chenghui and, protecting his earlier judgment, did not want Chenghui to settle the case. He ordered Chenghui to inspect dike works; Chenghui declined. Guoren then impeached him for acting high-handedly as a former governor-general and refusing control, stripped him of office, and recommended former Yan-Yi commissioner Tong Huai as administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 槐复劾承惠濫禁無辜，以罪人充捕擾民，譴戍伊犁，其去也，國仁送於候館，居民洶洶詈之，不及送而歸。

translations.literal: Huai again impeached Chenghui for indiscriminately imprisoning innocents and using convicts as catchers to harass the people; he was condemned to service at Yili; on his departure Guoren saw him off at the guest house while residents angrily cursed Guoren and he could not finish seeing Chenghui off before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Huai again impeached Chenghui for indiscriminately imprisoning innocents and using convicts as catchers to harass the people. Chenghui was condemned to Yili. On his departure Guoren saw him off at the guest house while residents angrily cursed Guoren, who could not finish the send-off before returning.

sentences.zh: 既而文誥訴於京，命尚書文孚往鞫，未至，槐倉卒定讞，釋文誥。

translations.literal: Soon Wengao appealed in the capital; the emperor ordered Minister Wen Fu to investigate; before he arrived Huai hastily fixed the verdict and released Wengao.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wengao appealed in the capital. The emperor ordered minister Wen Fu to investigate. Before he arrived, Huai hastily fixed the verdict and released Wengao.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，起承惠為湖北布政使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Chenghui was recalled as Hubei provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Chenghui was recalled as Hubei provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以衰老降戶部郎中。

translations.literal: A year later, on account of old age, he was demoted to director in the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, on account of old age, he was demoted to director in the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 尋引疾歸，卒於家。

translations.literal: Soon he cited illness and returned home, dying there.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he cited illness, returned home, and died there.

sentences.zh: 顏檢，字惺甫，廣東連平人，巡撫希深子。

translations.literal: Yan Jian, courtesy name Xingfu, was a native of Lianping in Guangdong, son of Governor Xishen.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Jian, courtesy name Xingfu, came from Lianping in Guangdong and was the son of Governor Xishen.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，乾隆四十二年，授禮部七品小京官，洊升郎中。

translations.literal: A tribute scholar; in the forty-second year of Qianlong he was appointed a seventh-rank junior capital official in the Board of Rites and was promoted in succession to director.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute scholar, in Qianlong year 42 he was appointed a seventh-rank junior capital official in the Board of Rites and rose in succession to director.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，出為江西吉安知府，擢雲南鹽法道，調迤南。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he went out as Ji'an prefect in Jiangxi, was promoted Yunnan salt commissioner, and transferred to Yunnan south circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 58 he became Ji'an prefect in Jiangxi, was promoted Yunnan salt commissioner, and transferred to the southern circuit.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，剿威遠介匪，擒匪首札杜。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he suppressed bandits between Weiyuan and Jie, capturing the bandit chief Zhaduo.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing year 2 he suppressed bandits between Weiyuan and Jie and captured bandit chief Zhaduo.

sentences.zh: 擢江西按察使，歷河南、直隸布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted Jiangxi administration commissioner and served in succession as Henan and Zhili provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted Jiangxi administration commissioner and served in succession as Henan and Zhili provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 五年，護直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he acted as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he acted as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 東明縣民李車因姦砍傷七歲幼童，從重擬絞決。

translations.literal: In Dongming County commoner Li Che, for adultery, hacked and wounded a seven-year-old child; from severity he was sentenced to strangulation after the usual stay.
translations.idiomatic: In Dongming County, commoner Li Che hacked and wounded a seven-year-old child in an adultery case and, on a severe reading, was sentenced to strangulation after the usual stay.

sentences.zh: 永年縣民樑自新勒斃繼妻及媳，訊因繼妻虐待前妻子有幅，縱媳與人通姦，同謀毒斃有幅，自新忿，將妻媳致死，從輕擬杖流。

translations.literal: In Yongnian County commoner Liang Zixin strangled to death his stepwife and daughter-in-law; inquiry showed the stepwife abused his son Youfu, allowed the daughter-in-law to commit adultery, and together plotted to poison Youfu; Zixin in anger killed wife and daughter-in-law and from leniency was sentenced to beating and exile.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongnian County, Liang Zixin strangled his stepwife and daughter-in-law. Inquiry showed the stepwife abused his son Youfu, allowed the daughter-in-law to commit adultery, and together plotted to poison Youfu; in anger Zixin killed wife and daughter-in-law and, on a lenient reading, was sentenced to beating and exile.

sentences.zh: 兩獄並為仁宗嘉許，特旨依議。

translations.literal: Both cases were together praised by Renzong, who issued a special edict to follow the recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong praised both cases together and issued a special edict to follow the recommendations.

sentences.zh: 樑自新加恩，再減杖徒。

translations.literal: Liang Zixin received additional grace and a further reduction of beating and penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Zixin received additional grace and a further reduction of beating and penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 先是直隸回贖旗地租銀，積欠至十三萬兩，前總督胡季堂、汪承霈屢議調劑，未有善策，檢疏請復旗租原額以紓民力，積欠得全減免焉。

translations.literal: Earlier Zhili's redemption of banner land rents had accumulated arrears to 130,000 taels; former governors-general Hu Jitang and Wang Chengpei had repeatedly discussed adjustment without a good plan; Jian memorialized to restore the original banner rent quota to ease the people's burden, and the accumulated arrears were wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhili's redemption of banner land rents had accumulated arrears of 130,000 taels. Former governors-general Hu Jitang and Wang Chengpei had repeatedly discussed adjustment without success. Jian memorialized to restore the original banner rent quota to ease the people's burden, and the arrears were wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔檢前護直督有治績，命以兵部侍郎銜署理直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year an edict said that in his earlier acting governorship of Zhili he had achievements in governance and ordered him to act as Zhili governor-general with vice-minister of war rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year an edict cited his achievements while acting Zhili governor and ordered him to act as Zhili governor-general with vice-minister of war rank.

sentences.zh: 尋實授，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Soon he received substantive appointment and was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He soon received substantive appointment and was granted a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 九年，京察，予議敘。

translations.literal: In the ninth year at the capital inspection he received merit evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, at the capital inspection, he received merit evaluation.

sentences.zh: 檢歷官畿輔，頗為仁宗所信任。

translations.literal: Jian had long served in the capital region and was quite trusted by Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: Jian had long served in the capital region and was quite trusted by Renzong.

sentences.zh: 尋以束鹿縣民王洪中與張文觀鬥毆被傷，上控，承審官偏聽，王洪中受責自縊，獄經部鞫，詔斥檢玩視重案，下部議革職，改留任。

translations.literal: Soon because in Shulu County commoner Wang Hongzhong and Zhang Wenguan fought and were wounded, Wang appealed upward, the trial officials were partial, Wang Hongzhong was punished and hanged himself; after the ministry reinvestigated, an edict rebuked Jian for treating a serious case lightly, the ministry recommended dismissal, and it was changed to dismissal but kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, in Shulu County, Wang Hongzhong and Zhang Wenguan fought and were wounded. Wang appealed upward; trial officials were partial; Wang was punished and hanged himself. After the ministry reinvestigated, an edict rebuked Jian for treating a serious case lightly. The ministry recommended dismissal, changed to dismissal but kept in office.

sentences.zh: 又因他獄屢被詰責，檢具疏陳謝，諭曰：「方今中外吏治，貪墨者少，疲玩者多。

translations.literal: Again on other cases he was repeatedly rebuked; Jian submitted a memorial of apology; an edict said: 'At present in official conduct inside and outside, the greedy are few but the slack and perfunctory are many.
translations.idiomatic: Rebuked again on other cases, Jian submitted a memorial of apology. An edict said: 'In official conduct today, inside and outside, the greedy are few but the slack and perfunctory are many.

sentences.zh: 因循觀望，大臣不肯實心，惟恐朕斥其專擅。

translations.literal: Dragging on and watching from the sidelines, great ministers will not act sincerely for fear the emperor will rebuke them for acting on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Dragging on and watching, great ministers will not act sincerely for fear I will rebuke them for acting on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 小官從而效尤，僅知自保身家。

translations.literal: Junior officials follow their example and only know how to protect themselves and their families.
translations.idiomatic: Junior officials follow their example and only know how to protect themselves and their families.

sentences.zh: 此實國家之隱憂，不可不加整頓。

translations.literal: This is truly a hidden worry of the state and cannot go without rectification.
translations.idiomatic: This is truly a hidden worry of the state and cannot go without rectification.

sentences.zh: 卿​​系朕腹心之臣，其勉之。

translations.literal: You are a minister in whom I trust my innermost thoughts; exert yourself.
translations.idiomatic: You are a minister in whom I trust my innermost thoughts; exert yourself.

sentences.zh: 十年，坐易州知州陳渼虧空逾十萬，查辦不力，降調革任，予主事銜，效力吉地工程處。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because Yizhou prefect Chen Mei had a deficit of more than 100,000 taels and investigation was handled weakly, he was demoted and dismissed from office, granted a principal official rank, and ordered to serve at the Jidi engineering office.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, because Yizhou prefect Chen Mei had a deficit of more than 100,000 taels and investigation was weak, he was demoted and dismissed, granted principal official rank, and ordered to serve at the Jidi engineering office.

sentences.zh: 會永定河堤壞，責隨築賠修。

translations.literal: When the Yongding River dike broke he was charged to follow construction and pay for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongding River dike broke he was charged to follow construction and pay for repairs.

sentences.zh: 又以刑部秋審，直隸省由緩改實者十四起，革主事銜，仍留工次，事竣，予五品銜，發南河委用。

translations.literal: Again at the autumn review of capital punishments in the Board of Punishments, fourteen cases in Zhili were changed from delayed execution to immediate execution; his principal official rank was stripped and he remained at the works; when the works ended he was given fifth-rank rank and sent to serve on the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Again, at the Board of Punishments autumn review, fourteen Zhili cases were changed from delayed to immediate execution. His principal official rank was stripped and he remained at the works. When the works ended he was given fifth-rank rank and sent to the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復因直隸官吏勾通侵帑事覺，革職，遣戍烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: Before long, again because Zhili officials' collusion in embezzling treasury funds was exposed, he was dismissed from office and sent to serve at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, again because Zhili officials' collusion in embezzling treasury funds was exposed, he was dismissed and sent to Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，釋回。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was released and returned.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命以主事充西倉及大通橋監督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to serve as principal official supervising the West Granary and Datong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to serve as principal official supervising the West Granary and Datong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授湖南嶽常澧道，遷雲南按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Hunan Yue-Chang-Li commissioner and transferred to Yunnan administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Hunan Yue-Chang-Li commissioner and transferred to Yunnan administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擢貴州巡撫，尋召來京。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted Guizhou governor and soon summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was promoted Guizhou governor and soon summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 坐前在直隸失察灤州民董懷信等傳習邪教，降二級，以京員用。

translations.literal: He was punished for earlier failure in Zhili to detect Luanzhou commoner Dong Huaixin and others propagating heterodox teachings, demoted two ranks, and used as a capital official.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for earlier failure in Zhili to detect Luanzhou commoner Dong Huaixin and others propagating heterodox teachings, demoted two ranks, and used as a capital official.

sentences.zh: 又坐涿州知州徐用書交代朦混，降補工部郎中。

translations.literal: Again, because Zhuozhou prefect Xu Yongshu confused his handover accounts, he was demoted and appointed director in the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because Zhuozhou prefect Xu Yongshu confused his handover accounts, he was demoted to director in the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 十九年，授山東鹽運使，命以三品頂戴為浙江巡撫，奏濬西湖興水利。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Shandong salt transport commissioner and ordered to serve as Zhejiang governor with third-rank insignia; he memorialized dredging West Lake to promote water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Shandong salt transport commissioner and ordered to serve as Zhejiang governor with third-rank insignia. He memorialized dredging West Lake to promote irrigation.

sentences.zh: 上素稱檢操守才幹，而病其不能猛以濟寬，屢加訓戒。

translations.literal: The emperor had long praised Jian's integrity and ability but faulted him for not using severity to balance leniency and repeatedly admonished him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had long praised Jian's integrity and ability but faulted him for not balancing leniency with severity and repeatedly admonished him.

sentences.zh: 二十年，武平民劉奎養聽糾入添弟會傳習徒眾論斬，詔斥檢未究編造逆書之人，下部議；

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Wuping commoner Liu Kuiyang, who had joined the Tiandihui and taught followers, was sentenced to execution by slicing; an edict rebuked Jian for not investigating those who compiled rebel writings and referred the case to the ministry for discussion;
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Wuping commoner Liu Kuiyang, who had joined the Tiandihui and taught followers, was sentenced to execution by slicing. An edict rebuked Jian for not investigating those who compiled rebel writings and referred the case to the ministry;

sentences.zh: 復因西湖厝棺被盜，言官劾其讞擬輕縱，命侍郎成格等往按，坐正犯由賄囑誣認，詔切責，褫職。

translations.literal: Again, because coffins stored at West Lake were stolen, censors impeached him for fixing verdicts too lightly; the emperor ordered Vice Minister Cheng Ge and others to investigate; he was found guilty because the principal offender had confessed under bribery and coercion; an edict sharply rebuked him and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because coffins stored at West Lake were stolen, censors impeached him for lenient verdicts. The emperor ordered vice minister Cheng Ge and others to investigate. He was found guilty because the principal offender had confessed under bribery and coercion. A sharp edict rebuked him and stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，祝嘏，予官，補刑部員外郎，逾年授福建巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, on congratulatory prayers for the emperor's longevity, office was granted; he was appointed outer-court official in the Board of Punishments and a year later made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on prayers for the emperor's longevity, office was restored. He was appointed outer-court official in the Board of Punishments and a year later made Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，疏陳歲進荔支樹、素心蘭採運艱難，詔永遠停貢，並嘉檢之直。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he memorialized that annual tribute of lychee trees and plain-heart orchids was hard to collect and transport; an edict permanently stopped the tribute and also praised Jian's frankness.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang year 1 he memorialized that annual tribute of lychee trees and plain-heart orchids was hard to collect and transport. An edict permanently stopped the tribute and praised Jian's frankness.

sentences.zh: 二年，复擢直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the second year he was again promoted Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was again promoted Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 先是籓司屠之申奏請直隸差徭，每地一畝攤徵銀一分，以示公平，詔俟檢到任定議；

translations.literal: Earlier Provincial Treasurer Tu Zhishen had memorialized that Zhili corvée labor should levy one fen of silver per mu of land for fairness; an edict said to decide after Jian took office;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier provincial treasurer Tu Zhishen had memorialized that Zhili corvée labor should levy one fen of silver per mu for fairness. An edict said to decide after Jian took office;

sentences.zh: 檢力言其不可行，請仍舊制。

translations.literal: Jian strongly said it could not be done and asked to keep the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Jian strongly said it could not be done and asked to keep the old system.

sentences.zh: 三年，以年老內召，授戶部侍郎，調倉場。

translations.literal: In the third year, on account of old age he was summoned within the capital and appointed vice minister of revenue, then transferred to granary administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on account of old age, he was summoned to the capital, appointed vice minister of revenue, then transferred to granary administration.

sentences.zh: 復出為漕運總督。

translations.literal: He went out again as grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He went out again as grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 五年，坐河淤滯運，降三品銜休致。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, because the canal silted and transport stalled, he was demoted to third rank and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, because the canal silted and transport stalled, he was demoted to third rank and retired.

sentences.zh: 尋復以疏請截留漕糧忤旨，降五品銜。

translations.literal: Soon again, because a memorial asking to retain grain transport grain offended the emperor, he was demoted to fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon again, because a memorial asking to retain transport grain offended the emperor, he was demoted to fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：馮光熊治苗疆善後，陸有仁興陝境寨堡團練，琅玕定石峴苗、維西夷，清安泰保全良將李長庚，常明佐勒保平仲苗，晚任蜀疆，鎮​​撫番夷，皆一時疆臣之能舉其職者。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Feng Guangxiong handled Miao border pacification well; Lu Youren raised stockade militia in Shaanxi border territory; Langgan settled the Shixian Miao and Weixi tribes; Qing Antai preserved the good general Li Changgeng; Chang Ming assisted Lebao in pacifying the Zhong Miao; in later years holding Sichuan frontier posts he pacified Tibetan tribes—all were frontier ministers of the time able to fulfill their duties.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Feng Guangxiong handled Miao border pacification well; Lu Youren raised stockade militia on the Shaanxi frontier; Langgan settled the Shixian Miao and Weixi tribes; Qing Antai preserved the capable general Li Changgeng; Chang Ming assisted Lebao in pacifying the Zhong Miao; in later years on the Sichuan frontier he pacified Tibetan tribes—all were frontier ministers of the day able to fulfill their duties.

sentences.zh: 溫承惠治畿輔無異績，陳臬山東，則治盜清獄有聲，卒以平反冤獄遭傾陷，可謂能晚蓋矣。

translations.literal: Wen Chenghui in governing the capital region had no special achievements; as administration commissioner in Shandong he was famed for suppressing bandits and clearing prisons, yet in the end was overthrown while reversing a wrongful case—one may say he was able to redeem himself in later years.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Chenghui governed the capital region without special achievement; as Shandong administration commissioner he was famed for suppressing bandits and clearing prisons, yet was overthrown while reversing a wrongful case—one may say he redeemed himself in later years.

sentences.zh: 顏檢明於吏事，治尚安靜，而屢以寬縱獲譴焉。

translations.literal: Yan Jian was clear in official affairs and governed by quiet methods, yet repeatedly was punished for leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Jian was clear in official affairs and favored quiet governance, yet was repeatedly punished for leniency.
